short_description.id: Rồng atau naga Vietnam adalah makhluk simbolis dalam cerita rakyat dan mitologi Vietnam, pembawa hujan dan lambang kaisar, yang menurut mitos asal-usul adalah leluhur bangsa Vietnam.
short_description.en: The rồng or Vietnamese dragon is a symbolic creature of Vietnamese folklore and mythology, a bringer of rain and emblem of the emperor, and in the origin myth an ancestor of the Vietnamese people.

long_description.id: Naga Vietnam, rồng, adalah makhluk simbolis dalam cerita rakyat dan mitologi Vietnam. Menurut mitos asal-usul kuno, bangsa Vietnam adalah keturunan seekor naga dan seorang makhluk abadi. Naga melambangkan pembawa hujan yang penting bagi pertanian, serta mewakili kaisar dan kemakmuran serta kekuatan bangsa.
long_description.en: The Vietnamese dragon, rồng, is a symbolic creature in the myths and folk tales of Vietnam. An ancient story of origins holds that the Vietnamese people descend from a dragon and an immortal. The dragon symbolizes the bringer of rain essential to agriculture and represents the emperor and the prosperity and power of the nation.

long_description.id: Dalam legenda penciptaan, Lạc Long Quân, raja bangsa naga, menikah dengan dewi peri Âu Cơ, yang melahirkan seratus telur yang menetas menjadi seratus putra. Putra sulung menjadi raja Lạc Việt dan bergelar Hùng Vương, dan dari kisah inilah lahir ungkapan Con Rồng, cháu Tiên: keturunan Naga dan Makhluk Abadi. Dalam penuturan lain, Lạc Long Quân kembali ke air bersama lima puluh anak, sedangkan Âu Cơ menetap di Delta Sungai Merah bersama lima puluh anak lainnya.
long_description.en: In the creation legend, Lạc Long Quân, king of the dragonkind, married the fairy goddess Âu Cơ, who bore a hundred eggs that hatched into a hundred sons. The eldest became king of Lạc Việt with the title Hùng Vương, and from this tale comes the saying Con Rồng, cháu Tiên: descendants of the Dragon and the Immortal. In another telling, Lạc Long Quân returned to the water with fifty children while Âu Cơ settled in the Red River Delta with the other fifty.

long_description.id: Citra naga Vietnam memadukan buaya, ular, kucing, tikus, dan burung. Karena orang Vietnam dahulu tinggal di dekat sungai, mereka memuja buaya sebagai thuồng luồng atau Giao Long, jenis naga Vietnam yang pertama. Bagi petani, naga adalah lambang awan, hujan, guntur, dan kilat; mereka percaya hujan diciptakan sembilan naga yang menuang air dari laut ke sawah, dan tarian naga dipakai untuk memohon hujan. Naga Vietnam digambarkan naik dari air, dan walau megah serta garang, tidak pernah mengancam.
long_description.en: The Vietnamese dragon’s image combines crocodile, snake, cat, rat and bird. Living beside rivers, the early Vietnamese honoured the crocodile, called thuồng luồng or Giao Long, which counts as the earliest Vietnamese dragon. For peasants the dragon symbolized clouds, rain, thunder and lightning; they believed rain was made by nine dragons pouring water from the sea onto the paddies, and the dragon dance was used to invoke rain. Vietnamese dragons were shown ascending from water and, though imposing and fierce, were never threatening.

long_description.id: Bentuknya berubah dari dinasti ke dinasti. Naga masa Lý langsing dan mengalir, bertubuh 12 ruas, bersirip kecil di punggung, tanpa tanduk, dan selalu menyimpan permata di mulutnya; menurut satu sumber museum, naga itu diturunkan dari Naga India. Naga masa Trần mendapat lengan dan tanduk serta melambangkan seni bela diri, naga masa Lê-Mạc megah dengan kepala singa dan kuku lima, dan naga masa Nguyễn mewakili para kaisar selatan yang perkasa.
long_description.en: Its form changed from dynasty to dynasty. The Lý dragon is slender and flowing, with a 12-section body, small fins on its back, no horns, and always a jewel in its mouth; according to one museum source it was derived from India’s Naga. The Trần dragon gained arms and horns and symbolized the martial arts, the Lê-Mạc dragon is majestic with a lion’s head and five claws, and the Nguyễn dragon represents the powerful southern emperors.

long_description.id: Naga terkait erat dengan kerajaan: para penguasa Vietnam memilihnya sebagai lambang kekuasaan, dan sebuah naskah kuno menyatakan naga emas untuk kaisar dan naga hitam untuk raja. Banyak nama tempat memuat kata naga, seperti Thăng Long, nama yang diberikan Kaisar Lý Thái Tổ pada 1010 setelah ia melihat naga emas, Teluk Hạ Long, dan Cửu Long. Pada masa dinasti Lê, naga digambarkan berkepala tegak, bertanduk bercabang, dan berkuku lima, dan merayap naik di pagar tangga Aula Kính Thiên. Kaitan naga dengan raja juga terlihat pada nama benda dan pribadi raja yang memuat kata long.
long_description.en: The dragon is closely tied to kingship: Vietnamese rulers chose it as the symbol of their power, and an ancient text states golden dragons for emperors and black dragons for kings. Many place-names contain the word for dragon, such as Thăng Long, the name Emperor Lý Thái Tổ gave in 1010 after he saw a golden dragon, Hạ Long Bay and Cửu Long. Under the Lê dynasty the dragon had a raised head, forked horn and five claws, and crept up the balustrade of the Kinh Thien Hall staircase. The tie between dragons and kings is also seen in the names of royal effects and the king’s person that contain the word long.

cultural_context.id: Naga Vietnam dikaitkan dengan hujan yang penting bagi pertanian dan dengan kaisar serta kemakmuran dan kekuatan bangsa; ia juga dilukiskan sebagai lambang yang, sedangkan satu sumber museum menyebut naga mula-mula dikaitkan dengan air dan energi yin. Naga digambarkan berkali-kali sebagai lambang nasional pada bendera, lambang negara, dan mata uang.
cultural_context.en: The Vietnamese dragon is tied to rain essential for agriculture and to the emperor and the prosperity and power of the nation; it is described as a symbol of yang, while one museum source says dragons were at first associated with water and yin energy. It has been depicted multiple times as a national symbol on flags, national emblems and currency.

claims.quote: Vietnamese dragons (Vietnamese: Rồng ... chữ Nôm: 蠬/蠪; Sino-Vietnamese: Long; chữ Hán: 龍) are symbolic creatures in Vietnamese folklore and mythology. According to an ancient origin myth, the Vietnamese people are descended from a dragon and an Immortal.

statement.id: Naga Vietnam (Rồng; Sino-Vietnam: Long; 龍) adalah makhluk simbolis dalam cerita rakyat dan mitologi Vietnam; menurut mitos asal-usul kuno, bangsa Vietnam adalah keturunan seekor naga dan seorang makhluk abadi.
statement.en: Vietnamese dragons (Rồng; Sino-Vietnamese: Long; 龍) are symbolic creatures of Vietnamese folklore and mythology; according to an ancient origin myth, the Vietnamese people are descended from a dragon and an Immortal.

claims.quote: The dragon was symbolic of bringing rain, essential for agriculture. It represents the emperor, the prosperity and power of the nation. Similar to the Chinese dragon (which has also influenced and appeared in Japan and Korea as fierce but benevolent serpentine dragons alike), the Vietnamese dragon is the symbol of yang, representing the universe, life, existence, and growth.

statement.id: Naga melambangkan pembawa hujan yang penting bagi pertanian, mewakili kaisar serta kemakmuran dan kekuatan bangsa; seperti naga Tiongkok yang galak tetapi baik hati, naga Vietnam adalah lambang yang: alam semesta, kehidupan, keberadaan, dan pertumbuhan.
statement.en: The dragon symbolized rain for agriculture and represents the emperor and the nation's prosperity and power; like the fierce but benevolent Chinese dragon, it is a symbol of yang: universe, life, existence and growth.

claims.quote: Lạc Long Quân, king of the dragonkind living near the Đông sea, married a fairy goddess, Âu Cơ who was the daughter of the birdkind emperor Đế Lai, descendant of Thần Nông. Âu Cơ bore 100 eggs, which hatched into 100 sons. The first-born son became the king of Lạc Việt, the first dynasty of Vietnam, and proclaimed himself Emperor Hùng Vương.

statement.id: Lạc Long Quân, raja bangsa naga, menikah dengan dewi peri Âu Cơ yang melahirkan 100 telur yang menetas menjadi 100 putra; putra sulung menjadi raja Lạc Việt dan bergelar Hùng Vương; dari sinilah ungkapan Con Rồng, cháu Tiên (keturunan Naga dan Makhluk Abadi).
statement.en: Lạc Long Quân, king of the dragonkind, married the fairy goddess Âu Cơ, who bore 100 eggs hatching into 100 sons; the eldest became king of Lạc Việt as Hùng Vương; hence the saying Con Rồng, cháu Tiên (descendants of Dragon and Immortal).

claims.quote: The Vietnamese dragon is the combined image of crocodile, snake, cat, rat and bird. Historically, the Vietnamese people lived near rivers, so they venerated crocodiles as "thuồng luồng" or "Giao Long", the first kind of Vietnamese dragon.

statement.id: Citra naga Vietnam memadukan buaya, ular, kucing, tikus, dan burung; karena tinggal dekat sungai, orang Vietnam memuja buaya sebagai thuồng luồng atau Giao Long, jenis naga Vietnam pertama.
statement.en: The Vietnamese dragon combines crocodile, snake, cat, rat and bird; living near rivers, the Vietnamese venerated crocodiles as thuồng luồng or Giao Long, the first Vietnamese dragon.

claims.quote: The body has 12 sections, symbolizing 12 months in the year. On the dragon's back are small, uninterrupted, regular fins. The head, held high, is in proportion with the body, and has a long mane, beard, prominent eyes, crest on nose (pointing forwards), but no horns.

statement.id: Naga masa Lý bertubuh 12 ruas yang melambangkan 12 bulan dalam setahun, bersirip kecil teratur di punggung, berkepala tegak dengan surai dan janggut panjang, mata menonjol, dan jambul di hidung, tetapi tanpa tanduk.
statement.en: The Lý-era dragon has a body of 12 sections symbolizing the 12 months of the year, small regular fins on its back, and a high-held head with a long mane, beard, prominent eyes and a crest on the nose, but no horns.

claims.quote: The Trần dynasty dragon was similar to that of the Lý dynasty but looked more rugged. The Trần dragon had new details: arms and horns.

statement.id: Naga masa Trần (1225–1400) mirip naga Lý tetapi lebih kekar, dengan tambahan lengan dan tanduk.
statement.en: The Trần dragon (1225–1400) resembled the Lý dragon but was more rugged, with new arms and horns.

claims.quote: On the brick from this period found in Cổ Loa, the dragon is short, with a cat-like body and a fish's backfin.

statement.id: Pada bata masa dinasti Ngô (938–965) dari Cổ Loa, naga bertubuh pendek seperti kucing dengan sirip punggung ikan.
statement.en: On a Ngô-dynasty (938–965) brick from Cổ Loa, the dragon is short with a cat-like body and a fish's back fin.

claims.quote: the dragons always keep a châu (gem/jewel) in their mouths (a symbol of humanity, nobility and knowledge). These dragons are able to change the weather, and are responsible for crops.

statement.id: Naga masa Lý selalu menyimpan châu (permata) di mulutnya, lambang kemanusiaan, kebangsawanan, dan pengetahuan; naga-naga ini dapat mengubah cuaca dan bertanggung jawab atas panen.
statement.en: The Lý-era dragons always keep a châu (gem/jewel) in their mouths, a symbol of humanity, nobility and knowledge; these dragons are able to change the weather and are responsible for crops.

claims.quote: The slender, flowing dragon of this period represents the vassal kingdom. These dragons rounded bodies curve lithely, in a long sinuous shape, tapering gradually to the tail.

statement.id: Naga masa Lý yang langsing dan mengalir melambangkan kerajaan bawahan; tubuhnya yang bulat melengkung luwes dalam bentuk panjang berliku dan mengecil bertahap ke ekor.
statement.en: The slender, flowing dragon of the Lý period represents the vassal kingdom; its rounded body curves lithely in a long sinuous shape, tapering gradually to the tail.

claims.quote: The Trần dragon symbolized the martial arts, because the Trần emperors were descended from a mandarin commander.

statement.id: Naga masa Trần melambangkan seni bela diri karena para kaisar Trần keturunan seorang panglima mandarin.
statement.en: The Trần dragon symbolized the martial arts, because the Trần emperors were descended from a mandarin commander.

claims.quote: These dragons were majestic, with lion-heads. Instead of a fiery crest, they have a large nose. Their bodies only curve in two sections. Their feet have five sharp claws.

statement.id: Naga masa Lê-Mạc megah dengan kepala singa; alih-alih jambul api, mereka berhidung besar, tubuhnya hanya melengkung di dua bagian, dan kakinya berkuku tajam lima.
statement.en: Dragons of the Lê-Mạc period were majestic, with lion-heads; instead of a fiery crest they have a large nose, their bodies curve in only two sections, and their feet have five sharp claws.

claims.quote: Dragons of Nguyễn dynasty represent the powerful southern emperors with glory and honor.

statement.id: Naga masa Nguyễn mewakili para kaisar selatan yang perkasa dengan kemuliaan dan kehormatan.
statement.en: Dragons of the Nguyễn dynasty represent the powerful southern emperors with glory and honor.

claims.quote: One group is that of the crocodile-dragons, with the head of a crocodile and the body of a snake.

statement.id: Salah satu kelompok naga yang ditemukan pada benda arkeologis adalah naga-buaya, berkepala buaya dan bertubuh ular.
statement.en: One group of dragons found on archaeological objects is the crocodile-dragons, with the head of a crocodile and the body of a snake.

claims.quote: In 1010, Emperor Lý Thái Tổ moved the capital from Hoa Lư to Đại La, which decision was explained in his Chiếu dời đô (Royal proclamation of moving capital): he saw a Rồng vàng (golden dragon) fly around on the clear blue sky, so he changed the name of Đại La to Thăng Long

statement.id: Pada 1010 Kaisar Lý Thái Tổ memindahkan ibu kota dari Hoa Lư ke Đại La; dalam maklumatnya ia menyatakan melihat seekor rồng vàng (naga emas) terbang di langit biru cerah, lalu mengganti nama Đại La menjadi Thăng Long.
statement.en: In 1010 Emperor Lý Thái Tổ moved the capital from Hoa Lư to Đại La; his proclamation explained that he saw a golden dragon (rồng vàng) fly in the clear blue sky, so he renamed Đại La as Thăng Long.

claims.quote: Hạ Long Bay (vịnh Hạ Long, lit. "Bay of Descending Dragon"), the section of the Mekong river flowing through Vietnam contains 9 branches and is called Cửu Long ("nine dragons")

statement.id: Banyak nama tempat di Vietnam memuat kata long atau rồng, misalnya Teluk Hạ Long ("Teluk Naga Turun") dan Cửu Long ("sembilan naga"), bagian Sungai Mekong yang mengalir di Vietnam.
statement.en: Many Vietnamese place-names incorporate the word for dragon, for example Hạ Long Bay ("Bay of Descending Dragon") and Cửu Long ("nine dragons"), the section of the Mekong river flowing through Vietnam.

claims.quote: The Vietnamese dragon has been depicted multiple times as national symbols on flags, national emblems, and currency.

statement.id: Naga Vietnam berkali-kali digambarkan sebagai lambang nasional pada bendera, lambang negara, dan mata uang.
statement.en: The Vietnamese dragon has been depicted multiple times as a national symbol on flags, national emblems and currency.

claims.quote: For Vietnamese peasants, the dragon was a vivid symbol of the fourfold deity-clouds, rain, thunder and lighting. Represented by an S shape, dragons are depicted on artifacts dating back to the Dong Son-Au Lac culture, which existed in northern Vietnam in the first millennium B.C.

statement.id: Bagi petani Vietnam, naga adalah lambang yang hidup dari dewa empat rupa: awan, hujan, guntur, dan kilat. Naga digambarkan berbentuk S pada benda-benda dari budaya Đông Sơn-Âu Lạc yang ada di Vietnam utara pada milenium pertama SM.
statement.en: For Vietnamese peasants the dragon was a vivid symbol of the fourfold deity of clouds, rain, thunder and lightning. Dragons, represented by an S shape, appear on artifacts from the Dong Son-Au Lac culture that existed in northern Vietnam in the first millennium B.C.

claims.quote: Lac Long Quan (King Dragon of the Lac Bird Clan) is known as the forefather of the Vietnamese people. He is said to have been the son of a dragon, while his wife, Au Co, was the child of a fairy. Their eldest son, King Hung, taught the people to tattoo their chests, bellies and thighs with dragon images to protect themselves from aquatic monsters.

statement.id: Lạc Long Quân (Raja Naga dari Suku Burung Lạc) dikenal sebagai leluhur bangsa Vietnam; ia disebut putra seekor naga, sedangkan istrinya, Âu Cơ, anak seorang peri. Putra sulung mereka, Raja Hùng, mengajari rakyat mentato dada, perut, dan paha dengan gambar naga untuk melindungi diri dari monster air.
statement.en: Lac Long Quan (King Dragon of the Lac Bird Clan) is known as the forefather of the Vietnamese people; he is said to be the son of a dragon, while his wife Au Co was the child of a fairy. Their eldest son, King Hung, taught the people to tattoo dragon images on their chests, bellies and thighs to protect themselves from aquatic monsters.

claims.quote: The Ly dragon was derived from India’s mythical Naga, which Southeast Asian peoples influenced by Indian mythology had transformed into a sea god.

statement.id: Naga masa Lý diturunkan dari Naga mitos India, yang oleh bangsa-bangsa Asia Tenggara yang dipengaruhi mitologi India diubah menjadi dewa laut.
statement.en: The Lý dragon was derived from India’s mythical Naga, which Southeast Asian peoples influenced by Indian mythology had transformed into a sea god.

claims.quote: Initially, dragons in Vietnam were associated with water and Yin energy. Dragons were popular among the common people, who believed that rain was created by nine dragons, which took water from the sea to pour down on the rice paddies.

statement.id: Pada mulanya naga di Vietnam dikaitkan dengan air dan energi yin. Rakyat jelata percaya hujan diciptakan sembilan naga yang mengambil air dari laut untuk dicurahkan ke sawah.
statement.en: Initially, dragons in Vietnam were associated with water and Yin energy; common people believed rain was created by nine dragons that took water from the sea to pour down on the rice paddies.

claims.quote: The dragon dance, a great favorite among people of all walks of life, was used to invoke rain.

statement.id: Tarian naga, favorit semua lapisan masyarakat, digunakan untuk memohon hujan.
statement.en: The dragon dance, a great favorite among people of all walks of life, was used to invoke rain.

claims.quote: But unlike the Chinese dragons, which were shown descending from heaven and spitting fire, the Vietnamese dragons were shown asecending from water. Though imposing and fierce, the Vietnamese dragons were never threatening.

statement.id: Berbeda dari naga Tiongkok yang digambarkan turun dari langit dan menyemburkan api, naga Vietnam digambarkan naik dari air; walau megah dan garang, naga Vietnam tidak pernah mengancam.
statement.en: Unlike Chinese dragons, shown descending from heaven and spitting fire, Vietnamese dragons were shown ascending from water; though imposing and fierce, they were never threatening.

claims.quote: “Golden dragons for emperors, black dragons for kings,” states this ancient text.

statement.id: Sebuah naskah kuno menyatakan: "naga emas untuk kaisar, naga hitam untuk raja".
statement.en: An ancient text states: "Golden dragons for emperors, black dragons for kings."

claims.quote: Like Chinese monarchs, Vietnamese sovereigns chose the dragon as the symbol of their power.

statement.id: Seperti raja-raja Tiongkok, penguasa Vietnam memilih naga sebagai lambang kekuasaan mereka.
statement.en: Like Chinese monarchs, Vietnamese sovereigns chose the dragon as the symbol of their power.

claims.quote: The Ly king had a cluster of shops and inns built up to the walls of an ancient temple once dedicated to the dragon deity. One night, the dragon deity revealed himself in the form of a violent northerly wind, which knocked down all of the houses but left the temple intact.

statement.id: Raja Lý membangun deretan toko dan penginapan hingga ke dinding sebuah kuil kuno yang dahulu dipersembahkan bagi dewa naga. Suatu malam dewa naga menampakkan diri sebagai angin utara yang dahsyat, merobohkan semua rumah tetapi membiarkan kuil itu utuh.
statement.en: The Lý king had shops and inns built up to the walls of an ancient temple once dedicated to the dragon deity; one night the dragon deity revealed himself as a violent northerly wind that knocked down all the houses but left the temple intact.

claims.quote: The dragon took on a whole new appearance under the Le Dynasty (early 15th to end of 18th centuries). With a raised head, forked horn, wide forehead, prominent nose, large, forceful eyes, five claws, and two splayed feet, a dragon crept up the balustrade of Kinh Thien Hall’s central staircase.

statement.id: Naga mendapat rupa yang sama sekali baru pada masa dinasti Lê (awal abad ke-15 hingga akhir abad ke-18): berkepala tegak, bertanduk bercabang, berdahi lebar, berhidung menonjol, bermata besar dan tajam, berkuku lima, dan berkaki dua yang terentang; seekor naga merayap naik di pagar tangga tengah Aula Kính Thiên.
statement.en: The dragon took on a whole new appearance under the Lê dynasty (early 15th to end of 18th centuries): a raised head, forked horn, wide forehead, prominent nose, large forceful eyes, five claws and two splayed feet; one dragon creeps up the balustrade of the central staircase of Kinh Thien Hall.

claims.quote: Taking this as a good omen, he named the new capital Thang Long, or City of the Soaring Dragon. The modern city of Hanoi stands on this same site.

statement.id: Menganggapnya pertanda baik, raja menamai ibu kota baru Thang Long, atau Kota Naga yang Terbang Menjulang; kota Hanoi modern berdiri di lokasi yang sama.
statement.en: Taking it as a good omen, the king named the new capital Thang Long, or City of the Soaring Dragon; the modern city of Hanoi stands on the same site.

claims.quote: That dragons, or long, associated with royalty, are revealed by the names given to the king’s personal effects and person, such as long con (royal tunics), long chau (royal boat), long thi (royal person), and long dien (royal countenance).

statement.id: Kaitan naga dengan kerajaan tampak pada nama benda dan pribadi raja, seperti long con (jubah raja), long chau (perahu raja), long thi (pribadi raja), dan long dien (wajah raja).
statement.en: The association of dragons (long) with royalty is revealed by the names given to the king’s effects and person, such as long con (royal tunics), long chau (royal boat), long thi (royal person) and long dien (royal countenance).

claims.quote: According to Vietnamese folklore, the Hung Vuong were descendants of dragons and fairies. A sea dragon lord, known as Lac Long Quan, was said to have fathered a hundred children by a princess of the mountains, named Au Co.

statement.id: Menurut cerita rakyat Vietnam, para Hùng Vương adalah keturunan naga dan peri; seorang penguasa naga laut bernama Lạc Long Quân dikatakan memperanakkan seratus anak dengan seorang putri gunung bernama Âu Cơ.
statement.en: According to Vietnamese folklore, the Hùng Vương were descendants of dragons and fairies; a sea dragon lord, Lạc Long Quân, was said to have fathered a hundred children by a mountain princess named Âu Cơ.

claims.quote: Lac Long Quan returned to the watery depths with 50 of their children, while Au Co settled in an area, which is the present-day Red River Delta, with the remaining 50, one of whom became the first Hung king.

statement.id: Lạc Long Quân kembali ke kedalaman air bersama 50 anak mereka, sedangkan Âu Cơ menetap di wilayah yang kini menjadi Delta Sungai Merah bersama 50 anak lainnya, yang salah satunya menjadi raja Hùng pertama.
statement.en: Lạc Long Quân returned to the watery depths with 50 of their children, while Âu Cơ settled in what is today the Red River Delta with the remaining 50, one of whom became the first Hùng king.

summary.id: Naga Vietnam adalah lambang yang: alam semesta, kehidupan, keberadaan, dan pertumbuhan.
summary.en: The Vietnamese dragon is a symbol of yang: universe, life, existence and growth.

summary.id: Pada mulanya naga di Vietnam dikaitkan dengan air dan energi yin (menurut sumber museum).
summary.en: Initially dragons in Vietnam were associated with water and yin energy (according to a museum source).

cultural_context.en: In Balinese belief the island-supporting giant turtle is linked to earthquakes and its ornament is placed at the base of meru buildings; sea turtles once offered in ceremonies may now be replaced by turtle-shaped images or rice cakes.

summary.en: In Balinese folk mythology a giant turtle supports the island of Bali on its back, and when it moves an earthquake occurs. To keep it from moving freely, Naga Basuki and Naga Anantabhoga are charged with coiling it and watching its every movement.

short_description.id: Bedawang Nala adalah penyu raksasa dalam mitologi Bali yang memikul seluruh dunia di punggungnya; bila ia bergerak, terjadilah gempa dan letusan gunung berapi.
short_description.en: Bedawang Nala is a giant turtle of Balinese mythology that carries the whole world on its back; when it moves, earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.

long_description.id: Bedawang Nala adalah penyu raksasa dari mitologi Bali yang memikul seluruh dunia di punggungnya. Dalam mitos penciptaan, ia disebut perubahan wujud Anantaboga dan, bersama dua ular naga, menopang dunia manusia. Bila ia bergerak, bumi diguncang gempa dan gunung berapi meletus.
long_description.en: Bedawang Nala is a giant turtle of Balinese mythology that carries the whole world on its back. In the creation myth it is a transformation of Anantaboga, and together with two dragon-serpents it supports the human world. When it moves, earthquakes and volcanic eruptions occur.

long_description.id: Menurut Wikipedia bahasa Prancis, Bedawang termasuk dalam mitos penciptaan Hindu Bali dan tercipta dari semadi ular kosmis Antaboga. Dua naga, Naga Basuki dan Naga Antaboga, yang melambangkan kebutuhan manusia, bertindak sebagai penstabil. Sebuah kajian jurnal menamai kedua naga yang membelit kura-kura itu Naga Basuki dan Naga Anantabhoga, yang melambangkan air dan tanah, dan menyebut bahwa mereka ditugaskan mengawasi dan mencegah setiap gerakan sang kura-kura.
long_description.en: According to the French Wikipedia, Bedawang is part of the Balinese Hindu creation myth and was created from the meditation of the cosmic serpent Antaboga. Two nagas, Naga Basuki and Naga Antaboga, representing human needs, act as stabilizers. A journal study names the two nagas coiling the turtle Naga Basuki and Naga Anantabhoga, symbolizing water and earth, and says they are charged with watching and preventing every movement of the turtle.

long_description.id: Dalam mitologi rakyat Bali dan Jawa, kura-kura raksasa digambarkan menyangga sebuah pulau di punggungnya, dan bila ia bergerak terjadilah gempa bumi. Ornamen bedawang nala lazimnya berwujud kura-kura raksasa berambut api dengan mulut berapi yang dibelit seekor atau dua ekor naga, dan menjadi dasar penyangga bangunan meru. Contohnya terdapat di Pura Taman Sari, Klungkung, dengan seekor naga, dan di Pura Kehen, Bangli, dengan dua naga. Secara umum, penggambaran Bedawang dalam seni dan ornamen terwujud dalam dua bentuk, yaitu teriomorfik dan terio-antropomorfik.
long_description.en: In Balinese and Javanese mythology a giant turtle is depicted supporting an island on its back, and when it moves an earthquake occurs. The bedawang nala ornament usually shows a giant turtle with fiery hair and a fiery mouth coiled by one or two nagas, forming the base that supports a meru building. Examples are at Pura Taman Sari, Klungkung, with one naga, and at Pura Kehen, Bangli, with two nagas. In general, Bedawang is represented in art and ornamentation in two forms, theriomorphic and therio-anthropomorphic.

long_description.id: Istilah bedawang nala berasal dari bahasa Sanskerta vadava, yang berarti kuda betina, dan berhubungan erat dengan Vadavamukha atau Vadavanala, kepala kuda betina berapi di dasar laut dalam mitologi Hindu di India; kata anala sendiri berarti api. Seorang peneliti menyebut konsep itu diadaptasi di Bali menjadi kura-kura berapi raksasa di dasar laut, karena menurut Hooykaas penyu sudah dikenal dan hidup di perairan Pulau Bali. Di alam nyata, kura-kura berapi itu dinyatakan sebagai simbol magma di perut bumi, dan sebagai simbol konsep neraka bila berada di dasar bangunan meru.
long_description.en: The term bedawang nala comes from the Sanskrit vadava, meaning a mare, and is closely related to Vadavamukha or Vadavanala, the head of a fiery mare on the seabed in Hindu mythology in India; the word anala itself means fire. One researcher says the concept was adapted in Bali into a giant fiery turtle on the seabed because, according to Hooykaas, turtles were well known and live in the waters of Bali. In the real world the fiery turtle is said to symbolize magma in the belly of the earth, and the concept of hell when placed at the base of a meru building.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita wayang, Bedawang Nala adalah seorang pendeta berasal dari pertapaan Gisik Samodra atau Eka Pratala, tinggal di sungai Wailu, dan memiliki Cupu Manik Astagina serta Cupu Tirta Manik berisi air kehidupan. Ia disebut berkekuatan gaib luar biasa dan mampu menghancurkan sebuah pulau dengan satu pukulan. Teks Korawasrama memuat kalimat "Nusa yawa kasangga de badawang nala". Penyu laut dahulu diburu dan dipersembahkan dalam upacara dengan kepalanya melambangkan Bedawang; kini para pemuka agama Bali menetapkan bahwa gambar atau kue beras berbentuk penyu boleh dipakai sebagai gantinya.
long_description.en: According to the puppet story, Bedawang Nala is a priest of the Gisik Samodra (or Eka Pratala) hermitage, living in the Wailu river and owning the Cupu Manik Astagina and Cupu Tirta Manik, vessels of the water of life. He is said to have extraordinary supernatural powers and to be able to make an island fall apart with one blow. The Korawasrama contains the sentence "Nusa yawa kasangga de badawang nala". Sea turtles were once hunted and offered in ceremonies with their heads symbolizing Bedawang; Balinese religious leaders now decree that a turtle-shaped image or rice cake may be used instead.

statement.en: The words ananta bhoga literally mean inexhaustible food; Naga Anantabhoga symbolizes the earth as the eternal source of food for all living beings.

claims.quote: Ornamen bedawang nala yang dibelit dua ekor naga serupa ini dapat ditemukan di dasar sebuah meru kuno di Pura Kehen, Kabupaten Bangli, Bali.

statement.id: Ornamen bedawang nala yang dibelit dua naga dapat ditemukan di dasar sebuah meru kuno di Pura Kehen, Kabupaten Bangli, Bali.
statement.en: A bedawang nala ornament coiled by two nagas can be found at the base of an old meru at Pura Kehen, Bangli Regency, Bali.

claims.quote: Ornamen bedawang nala yang dibelit seekor naga semacam ini terdapat di dasar bangunan meru di Pura Taman Sari, Kabupaten Klungkung, Bali.

statement.id: Ornamen bedawang nala yang dibelit seekor naga terdapat di dasar bangunan meru di Pura Taman Sari, Kabupaten Klungkung, Bali.
statement.en: A bedawang nala ornament coiled by one naga is found at the base of the meru building at Pura Taman Sari, Klungkung Regency, Bali.

claims.quote: Istilah “bedawang nala” memiliki hubungan yang kuat dengan nama Vadavamukha atau Vadavanala yang dikenal dalam mitologi Hindu di India.

statement.id: Istilah "bedawang nala" berhubungan erat dengan nama Vadavamukha atau Vadavanala dalam mitologi Hindu di India.
statement.en: The term "bedawang nala" is closely related to the name Vadavamukha or Vadavanala in Hindu mythology in India.

claims.quote: Vadavamukha atau Vadavanala adalah sebutan untuk sebentuk kepala kuda betina berapi yang terdapat di dasar laut.

statement.id: Vadavamukha atau Vadavanala adalah sebutan bagi kepala kuda betina berapi yang terdapat di dasar laut.
statement.en: Vadavamukha or Vadavanala is the name for the head of a fiery mare found on the seabed.

claims.quote: Adapun kata “anala” berarti api atau berapi.

statement.id: Kata "anala" berarti api atau berapi.
statement.en: The word "anala" means fire or fiery.

claims.quote: diadaptasi menjadi konsepsi bedawang nala lokal Bali yang digambarkan berbentuk seekor kura-kura berapi raksasa di dasar laut yang memiliki karakter serupa

statement.id: Konsep kepala kuda betina berapi di dasar laut diadaptasi di Bali menjadi konsep bedawang nala yang digambarkan sebagai kura-kura berapi raksasa di dasar laut dengan karakter serupa.
statement.en: The concept of the fiery mare's head on the seabed was adapted in Bali into the local bedawang nala concept, depicted as a giant fiery turtle on the seabed with a similar character.

claims.quote: Alasan adaptasi bentuk kepala kuda betina menjadi bentuk seekor kura-kura ini, menurut Hooykaas (1964: 108), adalah karena kura-kura ataupun penyu merupakan binatang yang cukup dikenal dan secara alamiah memang memiliki habitat asli di wilayah perairan Pulau Bali.

statement.id: Menurut Hooykaas (1964), bentuk kepala kuda betina diadaptasi menjadi kura-kura karena kura-kura atau penyu cukup dikenal dan secara alamiah berhabitat di perairan Pulau Bali.
statement.en: According to Hooykaas (1964), the mare's head became a turtle because turtles were well known and naturally live in the waters of Bali.

claims.quote: bedawang nala yang berwujud kura-kura raksasa berapi di dasar bangunan merupakan simbolisasi konsep neraka

statement.id: Bedawang nala berupa kura-kura raksasa berapi di dasar bangunan merupakan simbol konsep neraka.
statement.en: The bedawang nala, a giant fiery turtle at the base of the building, symbolizes the concept of hell.

claims.quote: Dalam mitologi rakyat Bali, digambarkan bahwa seekor kura-kura raksasa menyangga Pulau Bali di atas punggungnya. ... akan terjadi gempa bumi di Pulau Bali yang disangganya

statement.id: Dalam mitologi rakyat Bali, seekor kura-kura raksasa menyangga Pulau Bali di punggungnya, dan bila ia bergerak akan terjadi gempa bumi di Pulau Bali.
statement.en: In Balinese folk mythology a giant turtle supports the island of Bali on its back, and when it moves an earthquake occurs on the island.

claims.quote: Kedua naga kosmik ini ditugaskan selalu mengawasi dan mencegah setiap pergerakan sang kura-kura penyangga pulau.

statement.id: Kedua naga kosmik itu ditugaskan selalu mengawasi dan mencegah setiap gerakan kura-kura penyangga pulau.
statement.en: The two cosmic nagas are charged with constantly watching and preventing any movement of the island-supporting turtle.

claims.quote: Di alam nyata, kura-kura berapi Bedawang Nala dinyatakan sebagai simbol magma di perut bumi yang aktivitas vulkanisnya dapat memicu terjadinya gempa bumi dan tsunami.

statement.id: Di alam nyata, kura-kura berapi Bedawang Nala dinyatakan sebagai simbol magma di perut bumi yang aktivitas vulkaniknya dapat memicu gempa bumi dan tsunami.
statement.en: In the real world, the fiery turtle Bedawang Nala is said to symbolize magma in the belly of the earth, whose volcanic activity can trigger earthquakes and tsunamis.

claims.quote: In Javanese and Balinese mythology, it is depicted that a giant turtle supports an island on its back. If the giant turtle moves, an earthquake will occur.

statement.id: Dalam mitologi Jawa dan Bali, seekor kura-kura raksasa digambarkan menyangga sebuah pulau di punggungnya; bila kura-kura itu bergerak, terjadi gempa bumi.
statement.en: In Javanese and Balinese mythology a giant turtle is depicted supporting an island on its back; if the turtle moves, an earthquake occurs.

claims.quote: In Korawasrama there is a sentence 'Nusa yawa kasangga de badawang nala ... (Java Island is supported by Badawang Nala

statement.id: Dalam Korawasrama terdapat kalimat "Nusa yawa kasangga de badawang nala" yang diterjemahkan sebagai "Pulau Jawa ditopang oleh Badawang Nala".
statement.en: The Korawasrama contains the sentence "Nusa yawa kasangga de badawang nala", translated as "Java Island is supported by Badawang Nala".

claims.quote: In the puppet story, Bedawang Nala is a priest from the Gisik Samodra or Eka Pratala hermitage and lives in the Wailu river. He has the Cupu Manik Astagina and Cupu Tirta Manik which contain the water of life.

statement.id: Dalam cerita wayang, Bedawang Nala adalah seorang pendeta dari pertapaan Gisik Samodra atau Eka Pratala yang tinggal di sungai Wailu; ia memiliki Cupu Manik Astagina dan Cupu Tirta Manik yang berisi air kehidupan.
statement.en: In the puppet story, Bedawang Nala is a priest from the Gisik Samodra or Eka Pratala hermitage who lives in the Wailu river; he owns the Cupu Manik Astagina and Cupu Tirta Manik, which contain the water of life.

claims.quote: Bedawang Nala has extraordinary supernatural powers, he is able to make an island fall apart with just one blow.

statement.id: Bedawang Nala memiliki kekuatan gaib yang luar biasa dan mampu membuat sebuah pulau hancur hanya dengan satu pukulan.
statement.en: Bedawang Nala has extraordinary supernatural powers and can make an island fall apart with a single blow.

claims.quote: The term Bedawang Nala comes from the Sanskrit language 'vadava,' vadaba ', 'badava' or 'badaba' which means a stallion that resembles a mare, then also means a female horse.

statement.id: Istilah Bedawang Nala berasal dari bahasa Sanskerta "vadava", "vadaba", "badava" atau "badaba", yang berarti kuda jantan yang menyerupai kuda betina, juga berarti kuda betina.
statement.en: The term Bedawang Nala comes from the Sanskrit "vadava", "vadaba", "badava" or "badaba", meaning a stallion resembling a mare, also a female horse.

claims.quote: In general, the representation of Bedawang in art and ornamentation is manifested in two forms, namely theriomorphic and therio-anthropomorphic.

statement.id: Secara umum, penggambaran Bedawang dalam seni dan ornamen terwujud dalam dua bentuk, yaitu teriomorfik dan terio-antropomorfik.
statement.en: In general, Bedawang is represented in art and ornamentation in two forms, theriomorphic and therio-anthropomorphic.

text.id: Tokoh sastra dari novel yang pertama kali terbit secara anonim pada 1818.
text.en: A literary character from a novel first published anonymously in 1818.

short_description.id: Monster Frankenstein adalah makhluk ciptaan Victor Frankenstein dalam novel Mary Shelley (1818), sosok setinggi sekitar delapan kaki yang dihidupkan lalu ditinggalkan penciptanya.
short_description.en: Frankenstein's monster is the creature made by Victor Frankenstein in Mary Shelley's 1818 novel, a being of about eight feet in height who is brought to life and then abandoned by his creator.

long_description.id: Monster Frankenstein adalah tokoh fiksi, bukan makhluk dari cerita rakyat. Ia pertama kali muncul dalam novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus karya Mary Shelley (1818) sebagai antagonis utamanya. Novel itu pertama kali terbit secara anonim pada 1818 dan disebut Encyclopedia.com sebagai gabungan roman Gotik, petualangan fiksi ilmiah, dan kisah horor. Novel aslinya tidak memberi tokoh ini nama khusus; Victor Frankenstein menyebutnya antara lain "creature", "fiend", "wretch", dan "devil".
long_description.en: Frankenstein's monster is a fictional character, not a figure of folk tradition. He first appeared in Mary Shelley's novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus (1818) as its main antagonist. The novel was first published anonymously in 1818 and Encyclopedia.com describes it as equal parts Gothic romance, science-fiction adventure, and horror story. The original novel gives the character no specific name; Victor Frankenstein variously calls him the "creature", "fiend", "wretch", and "devil", among other terms.

long_description.id: Dalam novel, Victor menghidupkan makhluk itu pada suatu malam November dengan "percikan keberadaan" setelah mengumpulkan bahan dari rumah jagal, ruang bedah, dan tulang dari rumah mayat. Karena bagian tubuh yang kecil menyulitkan pekerjaannya, ia memutuskan membuat sosok bertubuh raksasa, sekitar delapan kaki tingginya. Anggota tubuhnya proporsional dan fitur wajahnya dipilih agar indah, tetapi kulit kuningnya nyaris tidak menutupi otot dan arteri, rambutnya hitam mengilap, giginya putih seperti mutiara, dan matanya berair. Begitu karyanya selesai, Victor dipenuhi kengerian dan rasa jijik. Menurut Wikipedia, Victor melakukannya di loteng rumah pondokannya di Ingolstadt. Pada awal novel, Walton dan awak kapalnya melihat sosok berbentuk manusia yang tampak bertubuh raksasa mengemudikan kereta luncur anjing.
long_description.en: In the novel, Victor brings the creature to life on a night in November with a "spark of being", after gathering materials from the dissecting room, the slaughter-house, and bones from charnel-houses. Because small parts hindered his work, he resolved to make the being of gigantic stature, about eight feet in height. The limbs are in proportion and the features were chosen as beautiful, yet the yellow skin scarcely covers the muscles and arteries beneath, the hair is lustrous black, the teeth pearly white, and the eyes watery. Once the work is finished, Victor is filled with breathless horror and disgust. According to Wikipedia, Victor does this in the attic of his boarding house in Ingolstadt. Early in the novel, Walton and his crew see a being of the shape of a man, apparently of gigantic stature, guiding a dog sledge.

long_description.id: Dalam kisahnya sendiri, makhluk itu mengingat awal keberadaannya sebagai rangkaian sensasi yang kacau. Ia lebih lincah daripada manusia, dapat hidup dengan makanan yang lebih kasar, dan tahan panas serta dingin dengan lebih sedikit kerusakan pada tubuhnya. Menurut Encyclopedia.com, ia belajar berbicara dengan mengamati sebuah keluarga, dan ia kemudian mendapat buku Paradise Lost, Plutarch's Lives, dan Sorrows of Werter. Ia menyebut dirinya ciptaan Frankenstein yang seharusnya menjadi Adam tetapi lebih seperti malaikat yang jatuh, dan mengatakan bahwa ia dahulu baik hati sebelum kesengsaraan membuatnya menjadi iblis. Sarjana Joseph Carroll menggambarkan sang monster sebagai tokoh yang menempati wilayah perbatasan antara ciri protagonis dan antagonis. Ia juga berkata bahwa ia jahat karena sengsara, dijauhi dan dibenci seluruh umat manusia.
long_description.en: In his own account, the creature remembers the start of his existence as a confused multiplicity of sensations. He is more agile than humans, can subsist on coarser diet, and bears heat and cold with less injury to his frame. According to Encyclopedia.com, he teaches himself to speak by observing a family, and he later obtains three books: Paradise Lost, Plutarch's Lives (one volume), and The Sorrows of Werter. He calls himself Frankenstein's creature who ought to have been Adam but is rather the fallen angel, and says he was benevolent and good until misery made him a fiend. The scholar Joseph Carroll places the monster in a borderland between the traits that usually mark protagonists and those that mark antagonists. He also says he is malicious because he is miserable, shunned and hated by all mankind.

long_description.id: Setelah ditolak keluarga yang ia amati, makhluk itu meminta Victor membuat pasangan yang sama buruk rupanya. Ia membunuh William, adik Victor, dan menuduh Justine Moritz. Victor membuat makhluk perempuan di sebuah pulau di Orkney tetapi menghancurkannya sebelum selesai; sang monster lalu mengancam akan bersama Victor pada malam pernikahannya, dan membunuh Henry Clerval serta Elizabeth Lavenza. Pada akhirnya sang monster berjanji mengumpulkan tumpukan kayu pemakamannya dan membakar tubuhnya di ujung paling utara dunia, lalu pergi dan tidak pernah terlihat lagi.
long_description.en: After being rejected by the family he observed, the creature asks Victor to make him a mate as hideous as himself. He kills Victor's younger brother William and frames Justine Moritz. Victor builds a female creature on an island in Orkney but destroys it before it is complete; the monster then threatens to be with Victor on his wedding night, and kills Henry Clerval and Elizabeth Lavenza. In the end the monster pledges to collect his funeral pile and consume his frame at the northernmost extremity of the globe, then departs, never to be seen again.

long_description.id: Wikipedia dan Encyclopedia.com mengaitkan judul novel dengan Prometheus dari mitologi Yunani, yang menurut Encyclopedia.com mencuri api dari Zeus dan memberikannya kepada manusia. Wikipedia menyebut citra monster yang paling dikenal dalam budaya populer berasal dari penampilan Boris Karloff dalam film Frankenstein (1931), dan menyatakan bahwa versi itu sangat sedikit menyerupai sumber aslinya.
long_description.en: Wikipedia and Encyclopedia.com link the novel's title to Prometheus of Greek mythology, who according to Encyclopedia.com steals fire from Zeus and gives it to mortals. Wikipedia says the monster's best-known popular image comes from Boris Karloff's performance in the 1931 film Frankenstein, and that this version resembles the source material very little.

cultural_context.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, subjudul novel, The Modern Prometheus, mengacu pada tema utamanya, dan Frankenstein dalam novel itu menyerupai Prometheus karena mengambil kekuatan seperti dewa saat menemukan rahasia penciptaan.
cultural_context.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, the subtitle The Modern Prometheus points to the novel's central theme, and Frankenstein, like Prometheus, takes on godlike powers on discovering the secrets of creation.

literal_meaning.id: "Monster milik Frankenstein": nama keluarga penciptanya, yang pada akhirnya dipakai untuk menyebut makhluk itu.
literal_meaning.en: "The monster of Frankenstein": the creator's family name, eventually used to refer to the creature.

who.id: Makhluk ciptaan Victor Frankenstein dari tubuh yang dirakit dan dihidupkan, dalam novel Mary Shelley.
who.en: The creature that Victor Frankenstein assembles and brings to life, in Mary Shelley's novel.

origin.id: Tokoh ciptaan Mary Shelley yang pertama muncul dalam novel yang terbit pada 1818.
origin.en: A character created by Mary Shelley who first appeared in the novel published in 1818.

role.id: Antagonis utama novel yang, setelah ditinggalkan penciptanya, mencari balas dendam.
role.en: The main antagonist of the novel who, after being abandoned by his creator, seeks revenge.

famous_for.id: Dikenal sebagai ikon horor, dan namanya sering disamakan dengan nama penciptanya.
famous_for.en: Known as a horror icon whose name is often conflated with that of his creator.

did_you_know.id: Pada 1823 Mary Shelley menghadiri pertunjukan panggung pertama novelnya dan menulis kepada temannya Leigh Hunt bahwa cara menamai yang tidak bernama itu "cukup bagus".
did_you_know.en: In 1823 Mary Shelley attended a stage adaptation of her novel and wrote to her friend Leigh Hunt that this nameless mode of naming the unnameable was rather good.

description.id: Menurut kisahnya sendiri, makhluk itu lebih lincah daripada manusia, dapat hidup dengan makanan yang lebih kasar, dan tahan panas dan dingin dengan lebih sedikit kerusakan pada tubuhnya.
description.en: By his own account, the creature is more agile than humans, can subsist on coarser diet, and bears extremes of heat and cold with less injury to his frame.

description.id: Victor melihat sosok itu mendekat dengan kecepatan di atas manusia, melompati celah-celah es.
description.en: Victor sees the figure advancing with superhuman speed, bounding over crevices in the ice.

description.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, makhluk itu mengajari dirinya berbicara setelah mengamati sebuah keluarga, dan kemudian mempelajari buku yang ditemukannya.
description.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, the creature teaches himself to speak after observing a family, and later learns from books he finds.

role.id: Antagonis utama
role.en: Main antagonist

summary.id: Victor Frankenstein menciptakan makhluk itu lalu lari ketakutan. Makhluk itu belajar dari sebuah keluarga, ditolak, dan menuntut pasangan dari penciptanya. Setelah Victor menghancurkan makhluk perempuan yang belum selesai, makhluk itu membunuh orang-orang yang dekat dengan Victor, dan akhirnya berjanji membakar dirinya sendiri di utara jauh.
summary.en: Victor Frankenstein creates the creature and flees in horror. The creature learns from a family, is rejected, and demands a mate from his creator. After Victor destroys the unfinished female creature, the creature kills people close to Victor and finally pledges to incinerate himself in the far north.

description.id: Tempat Victor belajar sains di universitas dan, menurut Wikipedia, membangun makhluk itu di loteng rumah pondokannya.
description.en: Where Victor studies science at the university and, according to Wikipedia, builds the creature in the attic of his boarding house.

description.id: Tempat, menurut Wikipedia, Victor membuat makhluk perempuan di sebuah pulau terpencil sebelum menghancurkannya.
description.en: Where, according to Wikipedia, Victor constructs a female creature on a remote island before destroying it.

name.en: The northernmost extremity of the globe

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, sang monster berjanji membakar dirinya di sini; dalam teks novel ia berjanji mengumpulkan tumpukan kayu pemakamannya dan membakar tubuhnya.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, the monster pledges to incinerate himself here; in the novel's text he pledges to collect his funeral pile and consume his frame.

description.id: Novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus pertama kali terbit secara anonim, memperkenalkan sang monster.
description.en: The novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus was first published anonymously, introducing the monster.

description.id: Mary Shelley menghadiri pertunjukan Presumption karya Richard Brinsley Peake, adaptasi panggung pertama yang sukses dari novelnya.
description.en: Mary Shelley attended a performance of Richard Brinsley Peake's Presumption, the first successful stage adaptation of her novel.

description.id: Sebuah gambar sang makhluk muncul dalam edisi 1831.
description.en: A picture of the creature appeared in the 1831 edition.

note.id: Pencipta sang makhluk; Wikipedia menyebut bahwa ia kemudian menjadi asal nama sang monster.
note.en: The creature's creator; Wikipedia says he later became the monster's namesake.

note.id: Judul novel membandingkan Victor Frankenstein, pencipta sang makhluk, dengan Prometheus dari mitologi.
note.en: The novel's title compares Victor Frankenstein, the creature's creator, to the mythological Prometheus.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, citra monster yang paling dikenal dalam budaya populer berasal dari penampilan Boris Karloff dalam film Frankenstein 1931.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, the best-known image of the monster in popular culture derives from Boris Karloff's portrayal in the 1931 movie Frankenstein.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam sekuel ini narasi pembingkai menyebut sang monster sebagai Frankenstein.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, in this sequel the frame narration refers to the monster as Frankenstein.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam novel Dean Koontz yang pertama kali terbit pada 2004, sang makhluk diberi nama Deucalion.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, in Dean Koontz's novel first published in 2004, the creature is named Deucalion.

description.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam film ini Ratu Gargoyle Leonore memberinya nama Adam karena Victor tidak pernah memberinya nama.
description.en: According to Wikipedia, in this film the Queen of the Gargoyles, Leonore, gives him the name Adam after understanding Victor never gave him one.

traditional.id: Menurut Wikipedia, dalam novel sang makhluk digambarkan jauh lebih lentur daripada manusia.
traditional.en: According to Wikipedia, in the novel the creature is described as much more flexible than a human.

modern.id: Menurut Wikipedia, sejak penampilan Karloff sang makhluk hampir selalu tampil sebagai sosok menjulang mirip mayat hidup, sering berkepala datar bersudut dan berbaut di leher, dan versi itu sangat sedikit menyerupai sumber aslinya.
modern.en: According to Wikipedia, since Karloff's portrayal the creature almost always appears as a towering, undead-like figure, often with a flat-topped angular head and bolts on his neck, and that version bears little resemblance to the source material.

learning_questions.id: Mengapa nama "Frankenstein" bisa bergeser dari pencipta ke makhluknya?
learning_questions.en: Why might the name "Frankenstein" have shifted from the creator to the creature?

learning_questions.id: Apa perbedaan antara makhluk dalam novel dan citra film yang lebih populer?
learning_questions.en: What differs between the creature in the novel and the more popular film image?

learning_questions.id: Bagaimana kita menimbang tanggung jawab pencipta terhadap ciptaannya dalam kisah ini?
learning_questions.en: How do we weigh a creator's responsibility for his creation in this story?
