claims.quote: It was on a dreary night of November that I beheld the accomplishment of my toils. With an anxiety that almost amounted to agony, I collected the instruments of life around me, that I might infuse a spark of being into the lifeless thing that lay at my feet.

statement.id: Victor menceritakan bahwa pada suatu malam November ia menyelesaikan karyanya dan mengumpulkan alat-alat kehidupan agar dapat menanamkan percikan keberadaan pada benda tak bernyawa di kakinya.
statement.en: Victor recounts that on a dreary night of November he completed his toils and collected the instruments of life so that he might infuse a spark of being into the lifeless thing at his feet.

claims.quote: I saw the dull yellow eye of the creature open; it breathed hard, and a convulsive motion agitated its limbs.

statement.id: Victor melihat mata kuning pudar makhluk itu terbuka; makhluk itu bernapas berat dan anggota tubuhnya digerakkan oleh gerak kejang.
statement.en: Victor sees the dull yellow eye of the creature open; it breathes hard and a convulsive motion agitates its limbs.

claims.quote: His limbs were in proportion, and I had selected his features as beautiful. Beautiful! Great God! His yellow skin scarcely covered the work of muscles and arteries beneath; his hair was of a lustrous black, and flowing; his teeth of a pearly whiteness; but these luxuriances only formed a more horrid contrast with his watery eyes

statement.id: Victor menggambarkan anggota tubuh makhluk itu proporsional dan fiturnya dipilih agar indah, tetapi kulit kuningnya nyaris tidak menutupi otot dan arteri, rambutnya hitam mengilap dan terurai, giginya seputih mutiara, dan semua itu hanya menambah kontras mengerikan dengan matanya yang berair.
statement.en: Victor describes the creature's limbs as in proportion and the features selected as beautiful, yet the yellow skin scarcely covers the muscles and arteries beneath, the hair is lustrous black and flowing, the teeth pearly white, and these only form a more horrid contrast with his watery eyes.

claims.quote: I resolved, contrary to my first intention, to make the being of a gigantic stature, that is to say, about eight feet in height, and proportionably large.

statement.id: Victor memutuskan, berlawanan dengan niat semula, membuat makhluk itu bertubuh raksasa, yaitu sekitar delapan kaki tingginya dan besar secara proporsional.
statement.en: Victor resolves, contrary to his first intention, to make the being of a gigantic stature, that is, about eight feet in height and proportionably large.

claims.quote: I collected bones from charnel-houses and disturbed, with profane fingers, the tremendous secrets of the human frame. ... The dissecting room and the slaughter-house furnished many of my materials

statement.id: Victor mengumpulkan tulang dari rumah mayat dan mengganggu rahasia besar tubuh manusia; ruang bedah dan rumah jagal menyediakan banyak bahan karyanya.
statement.en: Victor collects bones from charnel-houses and disturbs the tremendous secrets of the human frame; the dissecting room and the slaughter-house furnish many of his materials.

claims.quote: now that I had finished, the beauty of the dream vanished, and breathless horror and disgust filled my heart.

statement.id: Setelah karyanya selesai, keindahan mimpi Victor lenyap dan hatinya dipenuhi kengerian yang menyesakkan serta rasa jijik.
statement.en: Once his work is finished, the beauty of Victor's dream vanishes and breathless horror and disgust fill his heart.

claims.quote: I was more agile than they and could subsist upon coarser diet; I bore the extremes of heat and cold with less injury to my frame; my stature far exceeded theirs.

statement.id: Makhluk itu berkata ia lebih lincah daripada mereka, dapat hidup dengan makanan yang lebih kasar, tahan panas dan dingin dengan lebih sedikit kerusakan pada tubuhnya, dan jauh lebih tinggi.
statement.en: The creature says he was more agile than they and could subsist upon coarser diet, bore the extremes of heat and cold with less injury to his frame, and far exceeded their stature.

claims.quote: I suddenly beheld the figure of a man, at some distance, advancing towards me with superhuman speed. He bounded over the crevices in the ice, among which I had walked with caution; his stature, also, as he approached, seemed to exceed that of man.

statement.id: Victor melihat sosok seperti manusia mendekat dengan kecepatan di atas manusia, melompati celah-celah es, dan tingginya tampak melebihi manusia.
statement.en: Victor sees a figure of a man advancing with superhuman speed, bounding over the crevices in the ice, whose stature seems to exceed that of man.

claims.quote: a being which had the shape of a man, but apparently of gigantic stature, sat in the sledge and guided the dogs.

statement.id: Walton dan awak kapalnya melihat sosok berbentuk manusia tetapi tampak bertubuh raksasa duduk di kereta luncur dan mengemudikan anjing-anjingnya.
statement.en: Walton and his crew see a being with the shape of a man but apparently of gigantic stature sitting in a sledge and guiding the dogs.

claims.quote: I eagerly seized the prize and returned with it to my hovel. Fortunately the books were written in the language, the elements of which I had acquired at the cottage; they consisted of Paradise Lost, a volume of Plutarch’s Lives, and the Sorrows of Werter.

statement.id: Makhluk itu mengambil buku-buku yang ditulis dalam bahasa yang unsur-unsurnya telah ia pelajari di pondok, yaitu Paradise Lost, satu jilid Plutarch's Lives, dan Sorrows of Werter.
statement.en: The creature seizes books written in the language whose elements he acquired at the cottage: Paradise Lost, a volume of Plutarch's Lives, and the Sorrows of Werter.

claims.quote: Remember that I am thy creature; I ought to be thy Adam, but I am rather the fallen angel, whom thou drivest from joy for no misdeed.

statement.id: Makhluk itu berkata kepada Frankenstein bahwa ia adalah ciptaannya, yang seharusnya menjadi Adam tetapi lebih seperti malaikat yang jatuh, yang diusir dari kegembiraan tanpa kesalahan.
statement.en: The creature tells Frankenstein that he is his creature, who ought to be his Adam but is rather the fallen angel whom he drives from joy for no misdeed.

claims.quote: I was benevolent and good; misery made me a fiend.

statement.id: Makhluk itu berkata bahwa ia dahulu baik hati dan baik, dan kesengsaraan membuatnya menjadi iblis.
statement.en: The creature says he was benevolent and good, and that misery made him a fiend.

claims.quote: I am malicious because I am miserable. Am I not shunned and hated by all mankind?

statement.id: Makhluk itu berkata ia jahat karena ia sengsara, dan bertanya apakah ia tidak dijauhi dan dibenci seluruh umat manusia.
statement.en: The creature says he is malicious because he is miserable, and asks whether he is not shunned and hated by all mankind.

claims.quote: I demand a creature of another sex, but as hideous as myself; the gratification is small, but it is all that I can receive, and it shall content me.

statement.id: Makhluk itu menuntut makhluk berjenis kelamin lain yang sama buruk rupanya, dan berkata bahwa hanya itu yang dapat ia terima dan itu akan memuaskannya.
statement.en: The creature demands a creature of another sex, as hideous as himself, saying it is all he can receive and it shall content him.

claims.quote: I grasped his throat to silence him, and in a moment he lay dead at my feet.

statement.id: Makhluk itu menceritakan bahwa ia mencengkeram leher seorang anak untuk membungkamnya dan dalam sekejap anak itu terbaring mati di kakinya.
statement.en: The creature recounts that he grasped a child's throat to silence him and in a moment the child lay dead at his feet.

claims.quote: It is well. I go; but remember, I shall be with you on your wedding-night.

statement.id: Makhluk itu berkata kepada Victor bahwa ia pergi, tetapi mengingatkan bahwa ia akan bersama Victor pada malam pernikahannya.
statement.en: The creature tells Victor that he goes, but reminds him that he will be with him on his wedding-night.

claims.quote: I shall collect my funeral pile and consume to ashes this miserable frame, that its remains may afford no light to any curious and unhallowed wretch who would create such another as I have been.

statement.id: Makhluk itu berjanji mengumpulkan tumpukan kayu pemakamannya dan membakar tubuh malangnya sampai menjadi abu agar sisa-sisanya tidak memberi petunjuk kepada orang lain yang ingin menciptakan makhluk seperti dirinya.
statement.en: The creature pledges to collect his funeral pile and consume his miserable frame to ashes so that its remains may afford no light to anyone who would create such another as he has been.

claims.quote: It is with considerable difficulty that I remember the original era of my being; all the events of that period appear confused and indistinct. A strange multiplicity of sensations seized me

statement.id: Makhluk itu berkata sulit mengingat awal keberadaannya; peristiwa masa itu tampak kabur, dan serangkaian sensasi aneh menguasainya.
statement.en: The creature says it is with considerable difficulty that he remembers the original era of his being; the events appear confused and indistinct, and a strange multiplicity of sensations seized him.

claims.quote: First published anonymously in 1818, the book came to be regarded as Shelley's masterpiece and paved the way for such horror genre classics as Bram Stoker's Dracula and Robert Louis Stevenson's The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde.

statement.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, novel itu pertama kali terbit secara anonim pada 1818, dianggap sebagai mahakarya Shelley, dan membuka jalan bagi klasik horor seperti Dracula karya Bram Stoker dan The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde karya Robert Louis Stevenson.
statement.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, the book was first published anonymously in 1818, came to be regarded as Shelley's masterpiece, and paved the way for horror classics such as Bram Stoker's Dracula and Robert Louis Stevenson's The Strange Case of Dr. Jekyll and Mr. Hyde.

claims.quote: Equal parts Gothic romance, science-fiction adventure, and horror story, Frankenstein has spawned numerous stage and screen adaptations, emerging as an icon of modern popular culture.

statement.id: Frankenstein adalah campuran roman Gotik, petualangan fiksi ilmiah, dan kisah horor, melahirkan banyak adaptasi panggung dan layar serta menjadi ikon budaya populer modern.
statement.en: Frankenstein is equal parts Gothic romance, science-fiction adventure, and horror story, has spawned numerous stage and screen adaptations, and has emerged as an icon of modern popular culture.

claims.quote: Doctor Frankenstein soon becomes fixated on the idea of creating a superior race and uses the body parts of corpses to assemble a synthetic man, imbued with the spark of life through galvanic electrical power. When the creature comes to life, the doctor is repulsed by it and flees

statement.id: Dokter Frankenstein terpaku pada gagasan menciptakan ras unggul dan merakit manusia sintetis dari bagian tubuh mayat, yang diberi percikan kehidupan lewat tenaga listrik galvanik; ketika makhluk itu hidup, sang dokter muak dan lari.
statement.en: Doctor Frankenstein becomes fixated on the idea of creating a superior race and assembles a synthetic man from the body parts of corpses, imbued with the spark of life through galvanic electrical power; when the creature comes to life, the doctor is repulsed and flees.

claims.quote: In Greek mythology, Prometheus steals fire from Zeus, the ruler of the heavens, and gives it to the mortals for the benefit of mankind. Like Prometheus, Frankenstein assumes godlike powers when he uncovers the secrets of creation and fabricates a new life.

statement.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, dalam mitologi Yunani, Prometheus mencuri api dari Zeus dan memberikannya kepada manusia; seperti Prometheus, Frankenstein memperoleh kekuatan seperti dewa ketika menemukan rahasia penciptaan dan membuat kehidupan baru.
statement.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, in Greek mythology Prometheus steals fire from Zeus and gives it to mortals; like Prometheus, Frankenstein assumes godlike powers when he uncovers the secrets of creation and fabricates a new life.

claims.quote: Having spent the winter and spring observing a poor but loving family, the creature teaches himself to speak.

statement.id: Menurut Encyclopedia.com, setelah mengamati sebuah keluarga miskin tetapi penuh kasih selama musim dingin dan semi, sang makhluk mengajari dirinya berbicara.
statement.en: According to Encyclopedia.com, having spent the winter and spring observing a poor but loving family, the creature teaches himself to speak.

claims.quote: The creature tells Walton of his unbearable loneliness, expresses remorse for his actions, and leaves the ship to die alone on the ice.

statement.id: Sang makhluk menceritakan kesepiannya yang tak tertahankan kepada Walton, menyatakan penyesalan atas perbuatannya, dan meninggalkan kapal untuk mati sendirian di atas es.
statement.en: The creature tells Walton of his unbearable loneliness, expresses remorse for his actions, and leaves the ship to die alone on the ice.

claims.quote: Yet his attempt to approach the family is thwarted by his hideous appearance. The creature begs Frankenstein to provide him with a mate

statement.id: Upaya sang makhluk mendekati keluarga itu digagalkan oleh penampilannya yang mengerikan, dan ia memohon kepada Frankenstein agar menyediakan pasangan baginya.
statement.en: The creature's attempt to approach the family is thwarted by his hideous appearance, and he begs Frankenstein to provide him with a mate.

claims.quote: Frankenstein leaves home to study science at the University of Ingolstadt in Bavaria, Germany.

statement.id: Frankenstein meninggalkan rumah untuk belajar sains di Universitas Ingolstadt di Bavaria, Jerman.
statement.en: Frankenstein leaves home to study science at the University of Ingolstadt in Bavaria, Germany.

claims.quote: The novel adopts Frankenstein's perspective as he recounts his childhood in Geneva, Switzerland.

statement.id: Novel mengambil sudut pandang Frankenstein saat ia menceritakan masa kecilnya di Jenewa, Swiss.
statement.en: The novel adopts Frankenstein's perspective as he recounts his childhood in Geneva, Switzerland.

claims.quote: Frankenstein's monster, commonly referred to as Frankenstein, is a fictional character that first appeared in Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus as its main antagonist.

statement.id: Monster Frankenstein, yang biasa disebut Frankenstein, adalah tokoh fiksi yang pertama kali muncul dalam novel Mary Shelley tahun 1818, Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus, sebagai antagonis utamanya.
statement.en: Frankenstein's monster, commonly referred to as Frankenstein, is a fictional character that first appeared in Mary Shelley's 1818 novel Frankenstein; or, The Modern Prometheus as its main antagonist.

claims.quote: Mary Shelley's original novel does not give the character a specific name. In the novel, Victor Frankenstein variously refers to his creation as the "creature", "fiend", "spectre", "dæmon", "wretch", "devil", "thing", "being", and "ogre".

statement.id: Novel asli Mary Shelley tidak memberi tokoh ini nama khusus; Victor Frankenstein menyebut ciptaannya dengan berbagai istilah: creature, fiend, spectre, dæmon, wretch, devil, thing, being, dan ogre.
statement.en: Mary Shelley's original novel does not give the character a specific name; Victor Frankenstein variously refers to his creation as the creature, fiend, spectre, dæmon, wretch, devil, thing, being, and ogre.

claims.quote: Frankenstein's creation referred to himself as a "monster" at least once, as did the residents of a hamlet who saw the creature towards the end of the novel.

statement.id: Ciptaan Frankenstein menyebut dirinya "monster" setidaknya satu kali, begitu pula penduduk sebuah dusun yang melihatnya menjelang akhir novel.
statement.en: Frankenstein's creation referred to himself as a "monster" at least once, as did the residents of a hamlet who saw the creature towards the end of the novel.

claims.quote: Shelley's title compares the monster's creator, Victor Frankenstein, who later became the monster's namesake, to the mythological character Prometheus, who fashioned humans out of clay and gave them fire.

statement.id: Judul karya Shelley membandingkan pencipta sang monster, Victor Frankenstein, yang kemudian menjadi asal nama sang monster, dengan tokoh mitologi Prometheus, yang membentuk manusia dari tanah liat dan memberi mereka api.
statement.en: Shelley's title compares the monster's creator, Victor Frankenstein, who later became the monster's namesake, to the mythological character Prometheus, who fashioned humans out of clay and gave them fire.

claims.quote: According to the scholar Joseph Carroll, the monster occupies "a border territory between the characteristics that typically define protagonists and antagonists".

statement.id: Menurut sarjana Joseph Carroll, sang monster menempati "wilayah perbatasan antara ciri-ciri yang lazimnya menentukan protagonis dan antagonis".
statement.en: According to the scholar Joseph Carroll, the monster occupies "a border territory between the characteristics that typically define protagonists and antagonists".

claims.quote: The most popularly recognized version is Boris Karloff's portrayal of the monster in the 1930s films Frankenstein, Bride of Frankenstein, and Son of Frankenstein, though that incarnation bears little resemblance to the source material.

statement.id: Versi yang paling dikenal luas adalah penampilan Boris Karloff sebagai sang monster dalam film-film 1930-an Frankenstein, Bride of Frankenstein, dan Son of Frankenstein, meskipun wujud itu sangat sedikit menyerupai sumber aslinya.
statement.en: The most popularly recognized version is Boris Karloff's portrayal of the monster in the 1930s films Frankenstein, Bride of Frankenstein, and Son of Frankenstein, though that incarnation bears little resemblance to the source material.

claims.quote: Since Karloff's portrayal, the creature almost always appears as a towering, undead-like figure, often with a flat-topped angular head and bolts on his neck to serve as electrical connectors or grotesque electrodes.

statement.id: Sejak penampilan Karloff, sang makhluk hampir selalu tampil sebagai sosok menjulang mirip mayat hidup, sering berkepala datar bersudut dan berbaut di leher yang berfungsi sebagai penghubung listrik atau elektrode mengerikan.
statement.en: Since Karloff's portrayal, the creature almost always appears as a towering, undead-like figure, often with a flat-topped angular head and bolts on his neck serving as electrical connectors or grotesque electrodes.

claims.quote: (as opposed to the novel, in which he is described as much more flexible than a human)

statement.id: Wikipedia menyatakan bahwa, berbeda dengan versi film yang berjalan kaku, dalam novel sang makhluk digambarkan jauh lebih lentur daripada manusia.
statement.en: Wikipedia states that, as opposed to the stiff-legged film version, in the novel the creature is described as much more flexible than a human.

claims.quote: Victor Frankenstein builds the creature over a two-year period in the attic of his boarding house in Ingolstadt after discovering a scientific principle which allows him to create life from non-living matter.

statement.id: Victor Frankenstein membangun makhluk itu selama dua tahun di loteng rumah pondokannya di Ingolstadt setelah menemukan prinsip ilmiah yang memungkinkannya menciptakan kehidupan dari benda tak hidup.
statement.en: Victor Frankenstein builds the creature over a two-year period in the attic of his boarding house in Ingolstadt after discovering a scientific principle that allows him to create life from non-living matter.

claims.quote: Later, the monster boards the ship, but upon finding Frankenstein dead, is overcome by grief and pledges to incinerate himself at "the Northernmost extremity of the globe". He then departs, never to be seen again.

statement.id: Kemudian sang monster naik ke kapal, tetapi mendapati Frankenstein sudah mati, ia dikuasai duka dan berjanji membakar dirinya di "ujung paling utara dunia"; ia lalu pergi dan tidak pernah terlihat lagi.
statement.en: Later the monster boards the ship but, finding Frankenstein dead, is overcome by grief and pledges to incinerate himself at the northernmost extremity of the globe; he then departs, never to be seen again.

claims.quote: Within a decade of publication, the name of the creator, "Frankenstein", was used to refer to the creature, but it did not become firmly established until much later.

statement.id: Dalam satu dekade setelah terbit, nama sang pencipta, "Frankenstein", dipakai untuk menyebut makhluknya, tetapi pemakaian itu baru mapan jauh kemudian.
statement.en: Within a decade of publication the creator's name, "Frankenstein", was used to refer to the creature, but it did not become firmly established until much later.

claims.quote: In 1823, Shelley herself attended a performance of Richard Brinsley Peake's Presumption, the first successful stage adaptation of her novel.

statement.id: Pada 1823 Shelley sendiri menghadiri pertunjukan Presumption karya Richard Brinsley Peake, adaptasi panggung pertama yang sukses dari novelnya.
statement.en: In 1823 Shelley herself attended a performance of Richard Brinsley Peake's Presumption, the first successful stage adaptation of her novel.

claims.quote: she wrote to her friend Leigh Hunt. "This nameless mode of naming the unnameable is rather good."

statement.id: Shelley menulis kepada temannya Leigh Hunt bahwa cara menamai yang tidak bernama itu cukup bagus.
statement.en: Shelley wrote to her friend Leigh Hunt that this nameless mode of naming the unnameable is rather good.

claims.quote: Frankenstein agrees, and eventually constructs a female creature on a remote island in Orkney, but aghast at the possibility of creating a race of monsters, destroys the female creature before it is complete.

statement.id: Frankenstein setuju dan akhirnya membuat makhluk perempuan di sebuah pulau terpencil di Orkney, tetapi ngeri akan kemungkinan menciptakan ras monster, ia menghancurkannya sebelum selesai.
statement.en: Frankenstein agrees and eventually constructs a female creature on a remote island in Orkney but, aghast at the possibility of creating a race of monsters, destroys it before it is complete.

claims.quote: After leaving his creator, the creature goes on to kill Victor's best friend, Henry Clerval, and later kills Frankenstein's bride, Elizabeth Lavenza, on their wedding night, whereupon Frankenstein's father dies of grief.

statement.id: Setelah meninggalkan penciptanya, sang makhluk membunuh sahabat terbaik Victor, Henry Clerval, dan kemudian mempelai Frankenstein, Elizabeth Lavenza, pada malam pernikahan mereka, lalu ayah Frankenstein meninggal karena duka.
statement.en: After leaving his creator, the creature kills Victor's best friend Henry Clerval and later Frankenstein's bride Elizabeth Lavenza on their wedding night, whereupon Frankenstein's father dies of grief.

claims.quote: The best-known image of Frankenstein's monster in popular culture derives from Boris Karloff's portrayal in the 1931 movie Frankenstein, in which he wore makeup applied and designed by Jack P. Pierce

statement.id: Citra sang monster yang paling dikenal dalam budaya populer berasal dari penampilan Boris Karloff dalam film Frankenstein 1931, dengan riasan yang diterapkan dan dirancang oleh Jack P. Pierce.
statement.en: The best-known image of Frankenstein's monster in popular culture derives from Boris Karloff's portrayal in the 1931 movie Frankenstein, with makeup applied and designed by Jack P. Pierce.

claims.quote: However, in the sequel Bride of Frankenstein (1935), the frame narration by a character representing Shelley's friend Lord Byron does refer to the monster as Frankenstein.

statement.id: Dalam sekuel Bride of Frankenstein (1935), narasi pembingkai oleh tokoh yang mewakili teman Shelley, Lord Byron, menyebut sang monster sebagai Frankenstein.
statement.en: In the sequel Bride of Frankenstein (1935), the frame narration by a character representing Shelley's friend Lord Byron does refer to the monster as Frankenstein.

claims.quote: For example, in Dean Koontz's Frankenstein, first published in 2004, the creature is named "Deucalion", after the character from Greek mythology

statement.id: Dalam novel Frankenstein karya Dean Koontz yang pertama kali terbit pada 2004, sang makhluk bernama "Deucalion", sesuai tokoh dari mitologi Yunani.
statement.en: In Dean Koontz's Frankenstein, first published in 2004, the creature is named "Deucalion", after the character from Greek mythology.

claims.quote: Another example is the 2014 film I, Frankenstein, where the Queen of the Gargoyles Leonore gives him the name "Adam" after understanding Victor never gave him one.

statement.id: Dalam film I, Frankenstein (2014), Ratu Gargoyle Leonore memberinya nama "Adam" setelah memahami bahwa Victor tidak pernah memberinya nama.
statement.en: In the 2014 film I, Frankenstein, the Queen of the Gargoyles, Leonore, gives him the name "Adam" after understanding Victor never gave him one.

claims.quote: A picture of the creature appeared in the 1831 edition.

statement.id: Sebuah gambar sang makhluk muncul dalam edisi 1831.
statement.en: A picture of the creature appeared in the 1831 edition.

claims.quote: The monster kills Victor's younger brother William upon learning of the boy's relation to his creator and frames Justine Moritz, a young woman who lives with the Frankensteins, as the culprit

statement.id: Sang monster membunuh adik Victor, William, setelah mengetahui hubungan anak itu dengan penciptanya, dan menuduh Justine Moritz, seorang perempuan yang tinggal bersama keluarga Frankenstein, sebagai pelakunya.
statement.en: The monster kills Victor's younger brother William upon learning of the boy's relation to his creator and frames Justine Moritz, a young woman who lives with the Frankensteins, as the culprit.

summary.id: Encyclopedia.com meringkas bahwa sang makhluk meninggalkan kapal untuk mati sendirian di atas es.
summary.en: Encyclopedia.com summarizes that the creature leaves the ship to die alone on the ice.

summary.id: Dalam teks novel dan menurut Wikipedia, sang monster berjanji membakar dirinya di ujung paling utara dunia.
summary.en: In the novel's text and according to Wikipedia, the monster pledges to incinerate himself at the northernmost extremity of the globe.

gaps.searched: Novel Gutenberg dan ringkasan Wikipedia/Encyclopedia.com tidak menyatakan habitat tetap; tokoh ini berkelana, jadi dikosongkan.
Tidak ada kutipan yang secara langsung menyatakan sifat dari daftar taksonomi (mis. kekuatan super atau keabadian); kelincahan dan kecepatan ditulis di abilities.
Tidak ada kelemahan yang dinyatakan langsung oleh teks novel atau sumber sekunder yang dibuka.
Tidak ada ID budaya di taksonomi yang cocok untuk tokoh sastra Gotik; usulan tradisi baru diisi.

Teks Gutenberg #84 adalah teks novel dalam 24 bab; halaman itu tidak menyebut tahun edisinya, jadi entri ini tidak membedakan edisi 1818 dan 1831. Britannica, Library of Congress, dan British Library collection items menolak unduhan otomatis (HTTP 403).

research_refreshed.reason: Accepted research changed after selection (enrichment); every basis claim keeps its id, source and statement.

text.id: Tradisi Dugderan, tempat warak ngendog diarak, konon sudah ada pada 1881-1889 atau diduga dimulai sejak 1881; bentuk warak dikelompokkan dari sekitar 1930-an.
text.en: The Dugderan tradition, in which the warak ngendog is paraded, is said to date from 1881-1889, or presumably from 1881; warak forms are grouped from around the 1930s.

cultural_context.id: Masyarakat luas memaknai warak ngendog sebagai simbol akulturasi budaya Jawa, Arab, dan Cina di Semarang. Kajian jurnal yang dikutip menegaskan bahwa pada bentuk awalnya ia tidak dimaksudkan demikian, melainkan sarana menanamkan nilai keislaman kepada anak-anak, dan bahwa pesan moralnya adalah mengendalikan nafsu lewat puasa menuju kesucian.
cultural_context.en: The wider community reads the warak ngendog as a symbol of Javanese, Arab and Chinese acculturation in Semarang. The cited journal study stresses that in its original form it was not meant that way but as a means to instil Islamic values in children, and that its moral message is to control negative urges through fasting toward purity.

who.id: Hewan rekaan campuran yang membawa telur.
who.en: An imagined hybrid beast carrying eggs.

origin.id: Kota Semarang.
origin.en: The city of Semarang.

role.id: Maskot pawai Dugderan menjelang Ramadan.
role.en: Mascot of the Dugderan parade before Ramadan.

famous_for.id: Dimaknai masyarakat sebagai lambang tiga etnis Semarang.
famous_for.en: Read by the community as a symbol of Semarang's three ethnic groups.

did_you_know.id: Menurut satu kajian jurnal, pada bentuk awalnya warak ngendog tidak dimaksudkan sebagai simbol tiga budaya, melainkan binatang rekaan untuk mainan anak.
did_you_know.en: According to one journal study, the warak ngendog was originally not meant as a symbol of three cultures but as an imagined animal for a children's toy.

variants.name: Kepala naga, leher unta, badan kambing

description.id: Dalam kajian jurnal yang dikutip: badan kambing, leher unta, kepala naga.
description.en: In the cited journal study: goat body, camel neck, dragon head.

variants.name: Kepala naga, tubuh buraq dan kambing

description.id: Dalam Wikipedia: kepala naga (Tionghoa), tubuh perpaduan buraq (Arab) dan kambing (Jawa).
description.en: In Wikipedia: a dragon head (Chinese), a body combining the buraq (Arab) and a goat (Javanese).

description.id: Tempat pasar rakyat Dugderan digelar.
description.en: Where the Dugderan people's market is held.

description.id: Tempat bedug yang bunyinya memberi nama Dugderan.
description.en: Location of the drum whose sound gives Dugderan its name.

description.id: Tidak ada sumber tertulis yang pasti, tetapi ritual Dugderan diduga dimulai sejak 1881.
description.en: There is no definite written source, but the Dugderan ritual is presumed to have begun in 1881.

short_description.id: Warak ngendog adalah hewan rekaan khas Semarang, perpaduan beberapa hewan yang membawa telur, yang diarak dalam tradisi Dugderan menjelang Ramadan dan oleh masyarakat dimaknai sebagai lambang tiga etnis kota itu.
short_description.en: The warak ngendog is a fanciful beast of Semarang, a blend of animals carrying eggs, paraded in the Dugderan tradition before Ramadan and read by the community as a symbol of the city's three ethnic groups.

long_description.id: Warak ngendog adalah makhluk mitos yang menyerupai badak dengan telur di punggungnya. Ia dirayakan dalam Festival Dugderan di Semarang menjelang Ramadan dan diyakini mewakili tiga kelompok etnis di Semarang: Jawa, Tionghoa, dan Arab. Kepalanya seperti naga (Tionghoa), sedangkan tubuhnya perpaduan buraq (Arab) dan kambing (Jawa).
long_description.en: The warak ngendog is a mythical, rhinoceros-like beast that bears eggs upon its back. It is celebrated in Semarang's Dugderan Festival before Ramadan and is believed to represent three ethnic groups in Semarang: Javanese, Chinese and Arab. Its head is like a dragon (Chinese), while its body combines the buraq (Arab) and a goat (Javanese).

long_description.id: Sumber-sumber menggambarkan wujudnya sedikit berbeda. Satu kajian jurnal menyebutnya binatang rekaan berkaki empat dan berekor, berbadan seperti kambing, berleher panjang seperti unta, berkepala naga, dan berbulu keriting warna-warni seperti pitik walik. Wikipedia mencatat penggambaran sebagian jerapah, singa, naga Tionghoa, kuda, dan burung.
long_description.en: Sources describe its form somewhat differently. One journal study calls it an imagined four-legged, tailed animal with a goat-like body, a long camel-like neck, a dragon head and colourful curly feathers like the pitik walik. Wikipedia records descriptions as part giraffe, lion, Chinese dragon, horse and bird.

long_description.id: Warak ngendog dulu menjadi mainan anak yang sangat populer di Semarang dan dijual saat Dugderan, pasar rakyat yang digelar di Pasar Johar setiap bulan Syakban untuk menyambut Ramadan. Mainan itu berbentuk hewan berkaki empat dari kerangka kayu berbungkus bulu kertas warna-warni, dengan telur di antara kakinya. Seiring waktu ia menjadi maskot utama pawai Dugderan dan berubah menjadi patung raksasa, sementara sebagai mainan ia kian tergusur mainan modern.
long_description.en: The warak ngendog was once a very popular children's toy in Semarang, sold during Dugderan, a people's market held at Johar Market every month of Sya'ban to welcome Ramadan. The toy is a four-legged animal made of a wooden frame wrapped in colourful paper feathers, with an egg between its legs. Over time it became the main mascot of the Dugderan parade and grew into a giant statue, while as a toy it has been increasingly displaced by modern toys.

long_description.id: Nama Dugderan berasal dari bunyi bedug (dug) di Masjid Besar Semarang dan bunyi meriam (der). Tradisi ini konon sudah ada pada 1881-1889, saat Semarang diperintah Bupati Raden Mas Tumenggung Arya Purbaningrat, meskipun satu kajian menyebut tidak ada sumber tertulis yang pasti dan hanya menduga ia dimulai sejak 1881. Puncaknya adalah karnaval yang menampilkan warak ngendog bersama pasukan merah putih, drumband, dan meriam.
long_description.en: The name Dugderan comes from the sound of the drum (dug) at the Great Mosque of Semarang and the cannon (der). The tradition is said to date from 1881-1889, when Semarang was ruled by Regent Raden Mas Tumenggung Arya Purbaningrat, although one study says there is no definite written source and only presumes it began in 1881. Its climax is a carnival featuring the warak ngendog together with red-and-white troops, a drumband and cannons.

long_description.id: Menurut sebuah buku yang dirujuk detikJateng, kata warak diadaptasi dari bahasa Arab yang berarti suci, dan ngendog adalah kata Jawa yang bermakna bertelur. Tafsiran lain menyebut warak dalam bahasa Jawa berarti binatang mitos bertanduk seperti badak, atau berasal dari kata buraq; seorang informan kajian jurnal mengaitkannya dengan kata Arab waro'a yang berarti menghindari larangan Allah, dan kajian itu menyebut ngendog bermakna kemenangan. Telur disebut sebagai simbol kesucian.
long_description.en: According to a book cited by detikJateng, warak is adapted from the Arabic for holy, and ngendog is a Javanese word meaning laying eggs. Other readings say warak in Javanese means a horned mythical beast like a rhinoceros, or comes from buraq; an informant of the journal study links it to the Arabic waro'a, meaning to avoid what God forbids, and the study says ngendog carries the meaning of victory. The egg is described as a symbol of purity.

claims.quote: is a mythical creature resembling a rhinoceros carrying eggs on its back. ... celebrated during the Dugderan Festival held annually on September 23 a few days before the holiday of Ramadan, is believed to represent three different ethnic groups in Semarang: Javanese, Chinese and Arabian. Its head is like a dragon (Chinese), its body is the combination of buraq ... ; Arab) and goat (Javanese)

statement.id: Warak ngendog adalah makhluk mitos mirip badak dengan telur di punggungnya, dirayakan dalam Festival Dugderan menjelang Ramadan, dan diyakini mewakili tiga etnis di Semarang: Jawa, Tionghoa, dan Arab; kepalanya seperti naga (Tionghoa), tubuhnya perpaduan buraq (Arab) dan kambing (Jawa).
statement.en: The warak ngendog is a mythical creature like a rhinoceros carrying eggs, celebrated at the Dugderan Festival before Ramadan, believed to represent Semarang's Javanese, Chinese and Arab communities; its head is dragon-like (Chinese), its body combines the buraq (Arab) and a goat (Javanese).

claims.quote: Warak Ngendog is a children's toy that was once very popular in the city of Semarang and its surroundings, and is usually sold during the Dugderan Festival, a folk festival in Semarang held to welcome the coming of Ramadan.

statement.id: Warak ngendog adalah mainan anak yang dulu sangat populer di Semarang dan biasanya dijual saat Festival Dugderan untuk menyambut Ramadan.
statement.en: The warak ngendog is a children's toy once very popular in Semarang, usually sold at the Dugderan Festival welcoming Ramadan.

claims.quote: The highlight of Dugderan itself is the street festival where Warak Ngendog is paraded along the Semarang city area.

statement.id: Puncak Dugderan adalah pawai jalanan ketika warak ngendog diarak di kawasan kota Semarang.
statement.en: The highlight of Dugderan is the street festival where the warak ngendog is paraded through the city area of Semarang.

claims.quote: kata 'warak' diadaptasi dari bahasa Arab yang berarti suci, sedangkan 'ngendog' adalah kata Jawa dengan makna bertelur. Bila digabung, secara filosofis, warak ngendog adalah ajakan untuk menjaga kesucian diri pada bulan Ramadhan.

statement.id: Menurut buku yang dirujuk detikJateng, kata warak diadaptasi dari bahasa Arab yang berarti suci dan ngendog adalah kata Jawa yang bermakna bertelur; secara filosofis warak ngendog adalah ajakan menjaga kesucian diri pada bulan Ramadan.
statement.en: According to a book cited by detikJateng, warak is adapted from the Arabic for holy and ngendog is a Javanese word meaning laying eggs; philosophically the warak ngendog is a call to keep oneself pure in Ramadan.

claims.quote: Semisal, 'warak' dalam bahasa Jawa juga bisa diartikan sebagai binatang mitos dengan tanduk di wajahnya (identik dengan badak). Atau, 'warak' yang berasal dari kata 'buraq', binatang tunggangan Nabi Muhammad SAW.

statement.id: Tafsiran lain: warak dalam bahasa Jawa berarti binatang mitos bertanduk di wajah (identik dengan badak), atau berasal dari kata buraq, tunggangan Nabi Muhammad.
statement.en: Other readings: warak in Javanese means a horned mythical beast (like a rhinoceros), or comes from buraq, the Prophet Muhammad's mount.

claims.quote: warak ngendog juga tampak diselimuti bulu-bulu yang menempel secara terbalik. Bulu-bulu ini punya beragam warna yang mencolok mata, mulai dari merah, kuning, hingga putih terang.

statement.id: Warak ngendog tampak diselimuti bulu-bulu yang menempel terbalik, dengan warna mencolok dari merah, kuning, hingga putih terang.
statement.en: The warak ngendog is covered in feathers attached upside down, in eye-catching colours from red and yellow to bright white.

claims.quote: Nama Dugderan berasal dari bunyi bedug di Masjid Besar Semarang, yakni 'dug' dan bunyi meriam, yakni 'der'.

statement.id: Nama Dugderan berasal dari bunyi bedug di Masjid Besar Semarang (dug) dan bunyi meriam (der).
statement.en: The name Dugderan comes from the drum at the Great Mosque of Semarang (dug) and the cannon (der).

claims.quote: konon, Dugderan telah ada pada tahun-tahun 1881-1889. Kala itu, Semarang tengah diperintah oleh Kanjeng Bupati Raden Mas Tumenggung Arya Purbaningrat.

statement.id: Konon Dugderan sudah ada pada 1881-1889, saat Semarang diperintah Bupati Raden Mas Tumenggung Arya Purbaningrat.
statement.en: Dugderan reportedly existed by 1881-1889, when Semarang was ruled by Regent Raden Mas Tumenggung Arya Purbaningrat.

claims.quote: The Dugderan celebration itself is a public market that is held at the Johar Market every Sya'ban month in the Islamic calendar.

statement.id: Perayaan Dugderan sendiri adalah pasar rakyat yang digelar di Pasar Johar setiap bulan Syakban dalam kalender Islam.
statement.en: The Dugderan celebration itself is a public market held at the Johar Market every Sya'ban month of the Islamic calendar.

claims.quote: There will be a carnival which will be attended by red and white troops, drumband, warak ngendhog, residents who wear traditional clothes, cannons, and various other arts from Semarang.

statement.id: Pada puncak perayaan ada karnaval yang diikuti pasukan merah putih, drumband, warak ngendhog, warga berpakaian adat, meriam, dan berbagai kesenian lain dari Semarang; ejaan lain nama ini adalah warak ngendhog.
statement.en: At the festival's climax a carnival is held with red-and-white troops, a drumband, the warak ngendhog (an alternative spelling), residents in traditional dress, cannons and other arts from Semarang.

claims.quote: Warak Ngendog merupakan kreativitas budaya lokal yang menjadi maskot dalam tradisi ritual Dugderan masyarakat Kota Semarang.

statement.id: Warak Ngendog adalah kreativitas budaya lokal yang menjadi maskot dalam tradisi ritual Dugderan masyarakat Kota Semarang.
statement.en: The Warak Ngendog is a local cultural creation that became the mascot of the Dugderan ritual tradition of the people of Semarang.

claims.quote: Warak Ngendog bukanlah dimaksudkan sebagai simbol akulturasi budaya Cina, Jawa, dan Arab. Ia hanyalah sebuah binatang rekaan ... ulama sepuh yang ditujukan sebagai sarana penanaman nilai-nilai keIslaman kepada anak-anak dalam bentuk mainan.

statement.id: Menurut kajian ini, pada bentuk awalnya warak ngendog tidak dimaksudkan sebagai simbol akulturasi budaya Cina, Jawa, dan Arab, melainkan binatang rekaan ulama sepuh sebagai sarana menanamkan nilai keislaman kepada anak-anak lewat mainan.
statement.en: According to this study, in its original form the warak ngendog was not meant as a symbol of Chinese, Javanese and Arab acculturation but was an imagined animal of senior ulama, a toy to instil Islamic values in children.

claims.quote: Struktur mainan Warak Ngendog berbentuk hewan berkaki empat dibuat dengan struktur kayu yang dibungkus dengan bulu-bulu kertas mengkilap bewarna-warni.

statement.id: Mainan warak ngendog berbentuk hewan berkaki empat, dibuat dari kerangka kayu yang dibungkus bulu-bulu kertas mengilap warna-warni.
statement.en: The warak ngendog toy is a four-legged animal made of a wooden frame wrapped in glossy, colourful paper feathers.

claims.quote: Agar anak menjadi semakin senang maka pada bagian depan di antara kedua kakinya ditempatkan sebuah telur.

statement.id: Menurut kajian ini, agar anak-anak makin senang, sebuah telur diletakkan di bagian depan di antara kedua kaki mainan itu.
statement.en: According to this study, to please children more, an egg was placed at the front, between the toy's two legs.

claims.quote: bentuk Warak Ngendog merepresentasikan binatang rekaan sebagai hewan berkaki empat, berekor, berbadan seperti kambing, berleher panjang seperti unta, berkepala naga dan seluruh tubuhnya berbulu keriting seperti bulu pitik walik berwarna-warni.

statement.id: Bentuk warak ngendog adalah binatang rekaan berkaki empat dan berekor, berbadan seperti kambing, berleher panjang seperti unta, berkepala naga, dan seluruh tubuhnya berbulu keriting warna-warni seperti bulu pitik walik.
statement.en: The warak ngendog is an imagined four-legged, tailed animal with a goat-like body, a long camel-like neck, a dragon head and a body covered in colourful curly feathers like those of the pitik walik.

claims.quote: oleh masyarakat luas dimaknai sebagai simbol akulturasi budaya atas dasar pertimbangan karena keseluruhan perupaannya merepresentasikan simbol budaya tiga etnis warga masyarakat Kota Semarang, yaitu etnis Jawa (melalui perupaan badan kambing), etnis Arab (melalui perupaan leher unta), dan etnis Cina (melalui perupaan kepala naga).

statement.id: Masyarakat luas memaknai warak ngendog sebagai simbol akulturasi budaya karena perupaannya mewakili tiga etnis warga Semarang: Jawa (badan kambing), Arab (leher unta), dan Cina (kepala naga).
statement.en: The wider community reads the warak ngendog as a symbol of cultural acculturation because its form represents three ethnic groups of Semarang: Javanese (goat body), Arab (camel neck) and Chinese (dragon head).

claims.quote: kata warak berasal dari bahasa Arab waro’a, wariq yang berarti menghindari yang dilarang oleh Allah Swt.

statement.id: Menurut seorang informan penelitian ini, kata warak berasal dari bahasa Arab waro'a, wariq yang berarti menghindari yang dilarang oleh Allah.
statement.en: According to an informant of this study, the word warak comes from the Arabic waro'a, wariq meaning to avoid what God has forbidden.

claims.quote: Bentuk leher hingga kepala yang dibalut dengan bulu berwarna merah menyimbolkan watak jelek, negatif, atau angkara murka manusia. Sifat-sifat negatif manusia harus dihilangkan melalui laku puasa melalui simbolisasi bulu keriting seperti bulu pitik walik.

statement.id: Menurut informan penelitian ini, leher hingga kepala yang berbulu merah melambangkan watak buruk manusia, yang harus dihilangkan lewat puasa, dilambangkan oleh bulu keriting seperti bulu pitik walik.
statement.en: According to the study's informants, the red-feathered neck and head symbolize negative human traits, which must be removed through fasting, symbolized by the curly feathers like those of the pitik walik.

claims.quote: Telur adalah simbol kesucian layaknya janin yang ada dalam kandungan yang masih suci dari segala dosa.

statement.id: Menurut informan penelitian ini, telur adalah simbol kesucian, seperti janin dalam kandungan yang masih suci dari segala dosa.
statement.en: According to the study's informants, the egg is a symbol of purity, like a foetus in the womb that is still free of all sin.

claims.quote: Kata “Ngendog” dalam Bahasa Indonesia yang berarti telur memiliki makna kemenangan.

statement.id: Menurut kajian ini, kata ngendog, yang berarti telur, bermakna kemenangan.
statement.en: According to this study, the word ngendog, meaning egg, carries the meaning of victory.

claims.quote: Tidak ada sumber sejarah yang pasti secara tertulis kapan dimulainya ritual Dugderan namun diduga telah dimulai sejak 1881.

statement.id: Tidak ada sumber tertulis yang pasti tentang kapan ritual Dugderan dimulai, tetapi diduga sejak 1881.
statement.en: There is no definite written source on when the Dugderan ritual began, but it is presumed to have started in 1881.

claims.quote: Mainan Warak Ngendog inilah yang kemudian menjadi maskot utama dalam sebuah pawai atau kirab Dugderan. Wujudnya tidak lagi sebuah mainan tetapi telah menjadi patung raksasa

statement.id: Mainan warak ngendog kemudian menjadi maskot utama pawai atau kirab Dugderan, dan wujudnya tidak lagi sebuah mainan melainkan patung raksasa.
statement.en: The warak ngendog toy later became the main mascot of the Dugderan parade, no longer a toy but a giant statue.

claims.quote: Warak Ngendog semakin tergusur oleh mainan modern karena memang anak-anak lebih tertarik mainan modern yang lebih bervariatif bentuk dan jenisnya.

statement.id: Sebagai mainan, warak ngendog makin tergusur mainan modern karena anak-anak lebih tertarik pada mainan modern yang bentuk dan jenisnya lebih beragam.
statement.en: As a toy, the warak ngendog is increasingly displaced by modern toys because children are more drawn to modern toys of greater variety.

claims.quote: Hewan berbentuk imajiner, mulut menganga dan bertaring, leher dan kepala bewarna merah, dan struktur bentuk tubuh bergaris lurus.

statement.id: Bentuk tradisional (pakem) warak ngendog digambarkan sebagai hewan imajiner bermulut menganga dan bertaring, berleher dan berkepala merah, dengan tubuh bergaris lurus.
statement.en: The traditional (pakem) form of the warak ngendog is described as an imaginary animal with a gaping, fanged mouth, a red neck and head, and a straight-lined body.

claims.quote: bentuk Warak Ngendog modern terlihat secara struktur dan bentuk visualnya masih memiliki pakem atau simbolik namun terkadang sangat mengejar keindahan bentuk visualnya sehingga secara perlahan-lahan ada nilai-nilai simbolik yang mulai terabaikan.

statement.id: Bentuk warak ngendog modern masih memiliki pakem atau unsur simbolik, tetapi kadang sangat mengejar keindahan visual sehingga lambat laun nilai simbolik mulai terabaikan.
statement.en: Modern warak ngendog forms still keep the pakem or symbolic structure but sometimes pursue visual beauty so strongly that symbolic values are gradually neglected.

claims.quote: Berdasarkan rentang waktu dari sekitar 1930-an sampai sekarang, secara sederhana bentuk Warak Ngendog dapat dikelompokkan menjadi tiga bagian, yaitu struktur yang mengacu pada pakem (tradisional), modern, dan kontemporer.

statement.id: Dari sekitar 1930-an hingga kini, bentuk warak ngendog dapat dikelompokkan secara sederhana menjadi tiga: mengacu pakem (tradisional), modern, dan kontemporer.
statement.en: From around the 1930s to the present, warak ngendog forms can be grouped simply into three: following the pakem (traditional), modern, and contemporary.

claims.quote: The creature is described to be part giraffe, part lion, part Chinese dragon, part horse, and part bird and is made into popular toys for children to play with during the festival.

statement.id: Wikipedia menyebut makhluk ini digambarkan sebagian jerapah, sebagian singa, sebagian naga Tionghoa, sebagian kuda, dan sebagian burung, dan dijadikan mainan populer anak-anak saat festival.
statement.en: Wikipedia says the creature is described as part giraffe, part lion, part Chinese dragon, part horse and part bird, and is made into popular toys for children during the festival.

short_description.id: Krasue adalah hantu wanita nokturnal dalam cerita rakyat Asia Tenggara yang berwujud kepala melayang dengan organ dalam menggantung di bawah leher.
short_description.en: Krasue is a nocturnal female spirit in Southeast Asian folklore appearing as a floating head with internal organs trailing beneath the neck.

long_description.id: Dalam cerita rakyat di Thailand dan berbagai wilayah Southeast Asia, Krasue digambarkan sebagai roh wanita malam yang berwujud kepala melayang dengan organ dalam serta isi perut menjuntai dari lehernya [krasue-c01, krasue-c06, krasue-c07, krasue-c10]. Makhluk ini kerap menampakkan pendaran cahaya bercahaya redup di malam hari saat melayang melintasi desa dan persawahan [krasue-c02, krasue-c09, krasue-c11].
long_description.en: In folklore across Thailand and other parts of Southeast Asia, Krasue is portrayed as a nocturnal spirit appearing as a detached head with organs and entrails trailing below the neck [krasue-c01, krasue-c06, krasue-c07, krasue-c10]. The entity often emits a faint luminescent glow in the dark while hovering over villages and fields [krasue-c02, krasue-c09, krasue-c11].

long_description.id: Pada siang hari, sosoknya hidup menyamar sebagai wanita biasa dan menyembunyikan tubuh tanpa kepalanya di tempat sepi [krasue-c03, krasue-c17]. Saat malam tiba, kepalanya terlepas untuk berburu darah serta memangsa wanita hamil dan bayi baru lahir [krasue-c07, krasue-c15]. Jika tubuh tanpa kepalanya dihancurkan sebelum fajar menyingsing, makhluk tersebut akan binasa [krasue-c03, krasue-c04].
long_description.en: During the day, she lives disguised as an ordinary woman while concealing her headless body in a quiet place [krasue-c03, krasue-c17]. At night, her head detaches to hunt for blood, targeting pregnant women and newborn infants [krasue-c07, krasue-c15]. If her headless body is crushed before daybreak, the spirit suffers a fatal demise [krasue-c03, krasue-c04].

cultural_context.id: Mitos makhluk kepala melayang tersebar luas di kawasan Southeast Asia seperti Cambodia, Thailand, Laos, Malaysia, Indonesia, dan Philippines [krasue-c08, krasue-c13, krasue-c18]. Sebagian cerita rakyat mengaitkannya dengan wanita pelaku ilmu hitam yang mendapat kutukan turun-temurun [krasue-c12, krasue-c14]. Untuk menangkal serangannya terhadap wanita hamil, warga setempat menaruh pagar tanaman berduri di sekitar rumah [krasue-c05].
cultural_context.en: The floating head legend is shared across Southeast Asia including Cambodia, Thailand, Laos, Malaysia, Indonesia, and the Philippines [krasue-c08, krasue-c13, krasue-c18]. Tales often connect the entity to black magic practitioners and ancestral curses [krasue-c12, krasue-c14]. To safeguard pregnant women, villagers place thorny barriers around their houses to discourage the spirit [krasue-c05].

short_description.id: Nang Tani adalah roh perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Thailand yang menghuni rumpun pisang liar, digambarkan sebagai perempuan muda cantik berbusana hijau yang muncul pada malam bulan purnama.
short_description.en: Nang Tani is a female spirit of Thai folklore who dwells in clumps of wild banana trees, pictured as a beautiful young woman in green who appears on full-moon nights.

long_description.id: Nang Tani, yang berarti Nona dari Tani, adalah roh perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Thailand. Menurut tradisi rakyat, hantu ini tampil sebagai perempuan muda yang menghuni pohon pisang liar yang dalam bahasa Thai disebut kluai tani. Ia termasuk golongan hantu atau peri perempuan penghuni pohon yang disebut nang mai, dan roh serupa juga dikenal dalam cerita rakyat Kamboja dan Laos.
long_description.en: Nang Tani, meaning Lady of Tani, is a female spirit in the folklore of Thailand. Folk tradition says she takes the form of a young woman who haunts the wild banana trees known in Thai as kluai tani. She belongs to the tree-dwelling female ghosts or fairies known as nang mai, and a similar spirit is known in Cambodian and Lao tradition.

long_description.id: Ia digambarkan sebagai perempuan muda cantik berbusana tradisional Thai berwarna hijau. Kebanyakan waktu ia bersembunyi, tetapi keluar dari pohon dan menampakkan diri terutama pada malam bulan purnama. Kulitnya kehijauan menyatu dengan pohon, bibirnya merah, rambutnya hitam lebat terurai, dan kakinya melayang sedikit di atas tanah.
long_description.en: She is pictured as a beautiful young woman in green traditional Thai dress. Most of the time she stays hidden, but she comes out of the tree and shows herself especially on full-moon nights. Her greenish skin blends with the tree, her lips are red, her black hair is thick and loose, and her feet hover slightly above the ground.

long_description.id: Menebang pohon dari rumpun yang dihuni Tani dianggap pertanda buruk. Orang memberinya persembahan berupa kue manis, dupa, dan bunga, serta mengikatkan kain satin berwarna pada batang pohon pisang yang diyakini dihuninya. Karena kaitannya dengan hantu, pohon pisang jenis ini tidak ditanam di dekat rumah, tetapi sering tumbuh di pinggir desa atau di tepi ladang. Pisang kluai tani bukan varietas budidaya; pohonnya mirip pisang biasa tetapi buahnya tidak dapat dimakan, daunnya lazim dipakai untuk membungkus kue lokal, dan jantung pisangnya dipakai dalam pengobatan tradisional untuk bisul.
long_description.en: Cutting trees from the clump Tani inhabits is considered a bad omen. People offer her sweets, incense and flowers, and wrap lengths of coloured satin around the trunks of banana trees thought to be hers. Because of the ghostly link, this banana is not grown near houses, though clumps often grow at village edges or beside fields. The kluai tani banana is not a cultivated variety; it looks like an ordinary banana but its fruit is inedible, its leaves are commonly used to wrap local sweets, and its inflorescence is used in traditional medicine for ulcers.

long_description.id: Menurut legenda lisan Thai, roh ini dapat mencelakai laki-laki, terutama yang menyakiti perempuan, tetapi umumnya ia dianggap baik hati dan bahkan bisa memberi makanan kepada biksu yang lewat. Jimat bergambar Nang Tani populer, dan sosoknya muncul dalam film Thai seperti Nang Phrai Tani (1967), yang kini dianggap klasik.
long_description.en: Thai oral legend holds that she can bring harm to men, above all men who have mistreated women, yet she is mostly seen as benevolent and may even give food to passing monks. Amulets featuring Nang Tani are popular, and she appears in Thai films such as Nang Phrai Tani (1967), now considered a classic.

long_description.id: The Nation memuat Nang Tani dalam daftar hantu Thai populer dengan gambaran serupa: perempuan muda cantik berbusana tradisional Thai hijau yang kakinya tidak menyentuh tanah. Sebuah ulasan buku di jurnal Thai mencantumkan นางตานี di antara hantu-hantu Thai yang dibahas sebuah buku. Dalam budaya populer, ia digemari: komik dan buku cerita Thai kerap memuat kisah tentangnya, sebagian jenaka, dan sebagian penggambaran modern melukiskan bagian bawah tubuhnya sebagai kepulan yang keluar dari batang pohon.
long_description.en: The Nation lists her among popular Thai ghosts with a similar picture: a beautiful young woman in green traditional Thai dress whose feet do not touch the ground. A book review in a Thai journal lists นางตานี among the Thai ghosts covered by a book. In popular culture she is well liked: Thai comic books and story books often carry tales of her, some of them humorous, and some modern depictions show her lower body as a wisp rising from the tree trunk.

claims.quote: Nang Tani (Thai: นางตานี; "Lady of Tani") is a female spirit of the Thai folklore. According to folk tradition, this ghost appears as a young woman that haunts wild banana trees (Musa acuminata), known in Thai language as Kluai Tani (กล้วยตานี).

statement.id: Nang Tani (นางตานี, 'Nona dari Tani') adalah roh perempuan dalam cerita rakyat Thailand; menurut tradisi, hantu ini tampil sebagai perempuan muda yang menghuni pohon pisang liar yang disebut kluai tani.
statement.en: Nang Tani (นางตานี, 'Lady of Tani') is a female spirit of Thai folklore; by tradition this ghost appears as a young woman haunting wild banana trees called kluai tani.

claims.quote: Nang Tani belongs to a type of female ghosts or fairies related to trees known generically as Nang Mai (นางไม้; "Lady of the Wood") in the Thai lore. There is a similar spirit in the Cambodian folklore, as well as in the Lao popular tradition.

statement.id: Nang Tani termasuk golongan hantu atau peri perempuan penghuni pohon yang disebut nang mai; roh serupa ada dalam cerita rakyat Kamboja dan Laos.

statement.en: Nang Tani is also called Phi Tani ('Ghost of Tani') or Phrai Tani ('Nymph of Tani').

claims.quote: This ghost inhabits the clumps of wild banana trees and is popularly represented as a beautiful young woman wearing a green traditional Thai costume. Most of the time Phi Tani remains hidden, but she comes out of the tree and becomes visible especially on full moon nights.

statement.en: Her skin is greenish, blending with the tree, her lips red like ripe ivy gourd, her hair black, thick and loose, and her feet hover slightly above the ground.

claims.quote: It is considered a bad omen to cut trees from the clump Tani inhabits. Offerings are made to her in the form of sweets, incense sticks and flowers. People also often tie a length of colored satin cloth around the trunk of the banana tree believed to be haunted by her.

statement.id: Menebang pohon dari rumpun yang dihuni Tani dianggap pertanda buruk; orang memberinya kue manis, dupa, dan bunga, serta mengikatkan kain satin berwarna pada batang pohonnya.
statement.en: Cutting trees from Tani's clump is a bad omen; people offer sweets, incense and flowers, and tie coloured satin around the trunk.

claims.quote: Owing to their connection with ghosts, people prefer not to have them growing near their homes and they are not found within village compounds. However, clumps of this tree are found not far from inhabited areas, often at the outskirts of villages or at the edge of cultivated fields by the roadside.

statement.id: Karena kaitannya dengan hantu, orang tidak mau pohon ini tumbuh dekat rumah; rumpunnya sering ada di pinggir desa atau di tepi ladang dekat jalan.
statement.en: Because of the ghostly link, people avoid growing it near homes; clumps are often at village outskirts or at the edge of fields by the road.

claims.quote: Legends of the Thai oral tradition say that this spirit may harm men, especially those who have wronged women, but she is mostly considered benevolent. Nang Tani generally has a gentle disposition and may give food to passing Buddhist monks.

statement.id: Legenda lisan Thai menyebut roh ini dapat mencelakai laki-laki, terutama yang menyakiti perempuan, tetapi umumnya ia dianggap baik hati dan dapat memberi makanan kepada biksu yang lewat.
statement.en: Thai oral legend says this spirit may harm men, especially those who wronged women, but she is mostly seen as benevolent and may give food to passing monks.

claims.quote: Amulets featuring Nang Tani are popular and come in a variety of shapes and sizes.

statement.id: Jimat bergambar Nang Tani populer dan tersedia dalam berbagai bentuk dan ukuran.
statement.en: Amulets featuring Nang Tani are popular and come in many shapes and sizes.

claims.quote: Tani appeared as well in a Sylvania light bulb commercial for Thai audiences.

statement.id: Tani juga muncul dalam iklan bola lampu Sylvania untuk pemirsa Thailand.
statement.en: Tani also appeared in a Sylvania light bulb commercial for Thai audiences.

claims.quote: Bashōnosei: Japanese ghostly banana trees (Musa basjoo), they usually appear as a human face amongst the broad, flat banana leaves.

statement.id: Bashōnosei, pohon pisang berhantu dari Jepang, disebut sebagai hantu serupa; biasanya tampak sebagai wajah manusia di antara daun pisang.
statement.en: Bashōnosei, Japanese ghostly banana trees, are listed as a similar ghost; they usually appear as a human face among banana leaves.

claims.quote: Nang Tani is a popular folk spirit that has been featured in some Thai films such as Nang Phrai Tani (นางพรายตานี), a film made in 1967 that has become a classic.

statement.id: Nang Tani muncul dalam film Thai seperti Nang Phrai Tani (1967), yang telah menjadi klasik.
statement.en: Nang Tani features in Thai films such as Nang Phrai Tani (1967), which has become a classic.

claims.quote: and 2000 film Phrai Tani (พรายตานี), are less important movies in which the banana tree ghost plays the main role.

statement.id: Film Phrai Tani (2000) termasuk film yang kurang penting dengan hantu pohon pisang sebagai tokoh utama.
statement.en: The 2000 film Phrai Tani is among lesser films with the banana-tree ghost in the main role.

claims.quote: The Kluai Tani type of banana tree does not belong to the cultivated varieties.

statement.id: Pisang kluai tani bukan termasuk varietas budidaya.
statement.en: The Kluai Tani type of banana tree is not one of the cultivated varieties.

claims.quote: They look very much like average banana trees, but their fruits are not edible. Their leaves are commonly used in Thailand to wrap locally produced sweets and the inflorescence for the treatment of ulcers in traditional medicine.

statement.id: Pohon ini sangat mirip pisang biasa tetapi buahnya tidak dapat dimakan; daunnya lazim dipakai di Thailand untuk membungkus kue lokal dan jantung pisangnya untuk mengobati bisul dalam pengobatan tradisional.
statement.en: These trees look much like ordinary banana trees but their fruits are inedible; the leaves are commonly used in Thailand to wrap local sweets and the inflorescence is used against ulcers in traditional medicine.

claims.quote: In some modern representations the lower part of her body is represented with an immaterial quality, her waist cloth ending in a kind of wisp emanating from the tree trunk.

statement.id: Dalam sebagian penggambaran modern, bagian bawah tubuhnya dilukiskan tak berwujud padat, dengan kain pinggangnya berakhir seperti kepulan yang keluar dari batang pohon.
statement.en: In some modern representations the lower part of her body is shown as immaterial, her waist cloth ending in a wisp emanating from the tree trunk.

claims.quote: This female ghost is much loved in Thai popular culture, representations and stories about her, sometimes humorous, are common in Thai comic books and story books. Tani has a role as well in the Nak animated movie.

statement.id: Hantu perempuan ini sangat disukai dalam budaya populer Thai; penggambaran dan cerita tentangnya, kadang jenaka, lazim ada di komik dan buku cerita Thai, dan Tani juga berperan dalam film animasi Nak.
statement.en: This female ghost is much loved in Thai popular culture; representations and stories about her, sometimes humorous, are common in Thai comic books and story books, and Tani also has a role in the animated movie Nak.

cultural_context.id: Bagi orang Maranao, sarimanok adalah bagian penting warisan budaya, disebut dalam banyak ritual, dan sangat dihormati; ia tampil dalam desain seni dan arsitektur, ritual, tarian, dan perayaan.
cultural_context.en: For the Maranao, the sarimanok is an important part of their cultural heritage, is invoked in many rituals and is highly revered; it appears in artistic and architectural designs, rituals, dance and festivals.

summary.id: Menurut sebuah legenda, Rajah Indarpatra menikahi seorang nimfa air dan memiliki dua putra, satu terlihat dan satu tak terlihat. Yang terlihat menjadi leluhur orang Maranao masa kini, yang tak terlihat adalah roh yang dihormati dalam ritual. Keduanya berjanji saling melindungi dari roh jahat dan memilih Sarimanok sebagai burung totem, yang dengan bantuan kembarannya, Inikadowa, menjadi penghubung kedua dunia.
summary.en: According to one legend, Rajah Indarpatra married a water nymph and had two sons, one seen and one unseen. The seen one became the ancestor of today's Maranao and the unseen one is the spirit honoured in rituals. The brothers pledged to protect each other from bad spirits and chose the Sarimanok as their totem bird, which, with the help of its twin Inikadowa, became the link between the two worlds.

short_description.id: Sarimanok adalah burung legenda orang Maranao di Mindanao, Filipina, yang digambarkan berbulu warna-warni dan membawa ikan di paruh atau cakarnya, lambang keberuntungan dalam seni Maranao.
short_description.en: The sarimanok is a legendary bird of the Maranao of Mindanao, Philippines, pictured with colourful plumage and a fish in its beak or talons, a symbol of good fortune in Maranao art.

long_description.id: Sarimanok, yang bentuk betinanya disebut papanok, adalah burung legenda orang Maranao dari Mindanao, Filipina. Namanya berasal dari sari, yang berarti beraneka, dan manok, yang dulu berarti burung tetapi kini berarti ayam, sehingga namanya bermakna burung atau ayam beraneka warna.
long_description.en: The sarimanok, whose female form is called papanok, is a legendary bird of the Maranao people of Mindanao, Philippines. Its name comes from sari, meaning assorted, and manok, which once meant bird but now means chicken, so the name means bird or chicken of many colours.

long_description.id: Sarimanok menjadi lambang yang ada di mana-mana dalam seni Maranao. Ia digambarkan sebagai unggas bersayap warna-warni dan berekor bulu, membawa ikan di paruh atau cakarnya, dengan kepala yang dihiasi motif gulungan, daun, dan spiral, dan dikatakan melambangkan keberuntungan.
long_description.en: The sarimanok appears everywhere in Maranao art. It takes the form of a fowl with bright wings and a plumed tail, holding a fish in its beak or claws, its head richly decorated with scroll, leaf and spiral motifs, and is said to symbolize good fortune.

long_description.id: Sarimanok berasal dari burung totem orang Maranao bernama Itotoro, yang menurut mereka menjadi perantara ke dunia roh melalui kembarannya yang tak terlihat, burung roh Inikadowa. Menurut tradisi, sarimanok tidak pernah dipajang sendirian, melainkan bersama seperangkat bendera dan panji. Kini ia juga dapat dipasang di puncak payung seorang Sultan atau tokoh terhormat.
long_description.en: The sarimanok derives from a Maranao totem bird called Itotoro, which the Maranao say links people to the spirit realm by way of an invisible twin, the spirit bird Inikadowa. By tradition the sarimanok is never displayed alone, but with a set of flags and standards. Today it may also be placed on top of the umbrella of a Sultan or dignitary.

long_description.id: Menurut legenda Islam yang lebih kemudian, Muhammad menemukan seekor ayam jantan di langit pertama yang jenggernya menyentuh langit kedua; kokoknya membangunkan semua makhluk hidup kecuali manusia. Satu sumber mencatat bahwa asal-usul sarimanok tidak diketahui tetapi ia muncul dalam banyak legenda, termasuk kisah dua putra Rajah Indarpatra yang memilihnya sebagai burung totem dan penghubung dunia yang terlihat dan tak terlihat. Ikan di paruhnya melambangkan makanan yang dipersembahkan kepada dunia roh.
long_description.en: A later Islamic legend has Muhammad finding a rooster in the first heaven so huge that its crest reached up into the second; its crowing is said to wake all living beings but humans. One source notes that the origin of the sarimanok is not known but that it features in many legends, including that of the two sons of Rajah Indarpatra, who chose it as their totem bird and the link between the seen and unseen worlds. The fish in its beak symbolises the food offered to the spirit world.

long_description.id: Orang Maranao percaya sarimanok membawa keberuntungan, dan sarimanok sangat dihormati serta tampil luas dalam desain seni dan arsitektur, ritual, tarian, dan perayaan. Sebuah danganan, gagang pedang upacara, memiliki kenop gading berbentuk sarimanok, yang disebut lambang kebangsawanan Maranao. Seniman nasional Abdulmari Asia Imao memakainya sebagai motif, dan jaringan televisi ABS-CBN menjadikannya maskot dari 1993 hingga 2000.
long_description.en: The Maranao believe the sarimanok brings good fortune, and it is highly revered and widely present in artistic and architectural designs, rituals, dance and festivals. A danganan, a ceremonial sword handle, has an ivory knob shaped as a sarimanok, described as the symbol of Maranao royalty. National Artist Abdulmari Asia Imao used it as a motif, and the ABS-CBN network made it its mascot from 1993 to 2000.

claims.quote: Sarimanok is an important part of the Maranao people’s cultural heritage, it is invoked in many rituals and it showcases their unique artistic geniuses.

statement.id: Sarimanok adalah bagian penting warisan budaya orang Maranao, disebut dalam banyak ritual, dan memperlihatkan kepiawaian seni mereka.
statement.en: The sarimanok is an important part of the Maranao cultural heritage, is invoked in many rituals and showcases their artistic genius.

claims.quote: The origin of the sarimanok is not known, but it is widely featured in numerous legends.

statement.id: Asal-usul sarimanok tidak diketahui, tetapi ia banyak muncul dalam berbagai legenda.
statement.en: The origin of the sarimanok is not known, but it features widely in numerous legends.

claims.quote: When Rajah Indarpatra married a water nymph, they had two sons: one who can be seen and the other, unseen. Seen became the ancestors of the modern-day Maranao people and Unseen is the spirit that they pay tribute to during rituals and rites.

statement.id: Dalam salah satu legenda, Rajah Indarpatra menikahi seorang nimfa air dan mereka punya dua putra, satu terlihat dan satu tak terlihat; yang terlihat menjadi leluhur orang Maranao masa kini, sedangkan yang tak terlihat adalah roh yang dihormati dalam ritual.
statement.en: In one legend, Rajah Indarpatra married a water nymph and they had two sons, one seen and one unseen; the seen one became the ancestor of today's Maranao and the unseen one is the spirit honoured in rituals and rites.

claims.quote: These two brothers made a pact that they will always protect each other from bad spirits and they chose the Sarimanok to be their totem bird and through the help of its twin, Inikadowa, it became the link between the seen and the unseen worlds.

statement.id: Kedua saudara itu berjanji saling melindungi dari roh jahat dan memilih Sarimanok sebagai burung totem mereka; dengan bantuan kembarannya, Inikadowa, ia menjadi penghubung dunia yang terlihat dan tak terlihat.
statement.en: The two brothers pledged to protect each other from bad spirits and chose the Sarimanok as their totem bird; with the help of its twin, Inikadowa, it became the link between the seen and unseen worlds.

claims.quote: The fish on the beak of the Sarimanok symbolises the food that the Maranao people offer to the spirit world.

statement.id: Ikan di paruh Sarimanok melambangkan makanan yang dipersembahkan orang Maranao kepada dunia roh.
statement.en: The fish on the sarimanok's beak symbolises the food that the Maranao offer to the spirit world.

claims.quote: The Maranaos believe that the Sarimanok will bring them good fortune and if the spirits are pleased, they will have a bountiful harvest.

statement.id: Orang Maranao percaya Sarimanok membawa keberuntungan, dan bila roh senang, panen mereka akan melimpah.
statement.en: The Maranao believe the sarimanok brings good fortune and, if the spirits are pleased, a bountiful harvest.

claims.quote: the Sarimanok is highly revered by the Maranaos and has become an integral part of their culture and widely present in their artistic and architectural designs, rituals, dance and festivals.

statement.id: Sarimanok sangat dihormati orang Maranao dan menjadi bagian tak terpisahkan dari budaya mereka, tampil luas dalam desain seni dan arsitektur, ritual, tarian, dan perayaan.
statement.en: The sarimanok is highly revered by the Maranao and has become an integral part of their culture, widely present in artistic and architectural designs, rituals, dance and festivals.

claims.quote: Its crow roused every living creature except man. The Day of Resurrection would come once this celestial rooster ceased to crow.

statement.id: Dalam legenda Islam yang lebih kemudian itu, kokoknya membangunkan semua makhluk hidup kecuali manusia, dan Hari Kiamat tiba bila ayam jantan langit itu berhenti berkokok.
statement.en: In that later Islamic legend its crow roused every living creature except man, and the Day of Resurrection would come once the celestial rooster ceased to crow.

claims.quote: At present, this is not totally true; sarimanok may be placed on the top of the umbrella of a Sultan or dignitary, and also, the Mindanao State University has adopted it for the graduation exercises following a non-traditional use.

statement.id: Kini tradisi itu tidak sepenuhnya berlaku: sarimanok dapat ditaruh di puncak payung seorang Sultan atau tokoh terhormat, dan Mindanao State University memakainya untuk upacara wisuda dengan cara nontradisional.
statement.en: Today this is not entirely true: the sarimanok may be placed on top of the umbrella of a Sultan or dignitary, and Mindanao State University has adopted it for graduation exercises in a non-traditional use.

claims.quote: The Philippine float entry for the 1998 Tournament of Roses Parade featured a giant 55-foot Sarimanok which also won the "Most Beautiful Float from Outside the USA” honors.

statement.id: Kendaraan hias Filipina di Tournament of Roses Parade 1998 menampilkan Sarimanok raksasa setinggi 55 kaki yang juga meraih penghargaan "Most Beautiful Float from Outside the USA".
statement.en: The Philippine float in the 1998 Tournament of Roses Parade featured a giant 55-foot Sarimanok that also won the "Most Beautiful Float from Outside the USA" honors.

claims.quote: The Sarimanok was also the logo of Spirit of Manila Airlines, a short-lived airline which only lasted from 2011 to 2012.

statement.id: Sarimanok juga menjadi logo Spirit of Manila Airlines, maskapai berumur pendek yang hanya beroperasi dari 2011 hingga 2012.
statement.en: The sarimanok was also the logo of Spirit of Manila Airlines, a short-lived airline that lasted only from 2011 to 2012.
